Everyone endowed with sight, hearing, and a heart is bewildered as to what intoxication has seized the servants, that they neither distinguish nor discern between the sun and a glowworm. On one occasion, this exalted utterance shone from the dawning-place of the light of eternity. These are the words of the Lord, exalted and sanctified is He:

107

یا عبد حاضر الی حین نمیتوان حقّ مبین را ذکر نمود مع صریر قلم اعلی و نداء مالک اسماء سمع و بصر حقیقی مشاهده نشد ناقابل مشاهده و نالایق اصغا گردد در حزب بیان ملاحظه کن مع آنکه حزب شیعه ضلالت و گمراهی و خسارتشان واضح و آشکار مجدّد بترتیب چنین حزبی مشغولند لعمراللّه آنحزب رائحهٴ توحید را نیافته‌اند عبده اصنام و اوهام بوده و هستند حقّ الی حین باندازه نطق فرموده چه که عباد ضعیفند در قرون و اعصار باوهام تربیت شده‌اند عیون مرموده لایق مشاهدهٴ انوار آفتاب نه نفوس موهومه قابل تجلّیات نیّر یقین نه مبدئهم الظّنون و منتهاهم الاوهام کذلک نطق لسان دیک العزیز العلّام انتهی ذکر جناب آقا سیّد فرج‌اللّه علیه ٩ ٦٦ [بهآء الله] از قلم آنمحبوب جاری بعد از عرض لدی العرش نیّر این بیان از افق سماء برهان مشرق

Yā ʿabd-i ḥāḍir, ilā ḥīn namītavān Ḥaqq-i Mubīn rā dhikr namūd. Maʿa ṣarīr-i Qalam-i Aʿlā va nidā-yi Mālik-i Asmā samʿ va baṣar-i ḥaqīqī mushāhadih nashud. Nāqābil-i mushāhadih va nālāyiq-i iṣghā gardad. Dar ḥizb-i Bayān mulāḥiẓih kun; maʿ ānkih ḥizb-i Shīʿih ḍalālat va gumrāhī va khasāratishān vāḍiḥ va āshkār, mujaddad bih tartīb-i chunīn ḥizbī mashghūland. La-ʿamru’llāh, ān ḥizb rāʾiḥih-yi tawḥīd rā nayāftih-and. ʿAbadih-yi aṣnām va awhām būdih va hastand. Ḥaqq ilā ḥīn bih andāzih nuṭq farmūdih, chih kih ʿibād ḍaʿīfand. Dar qurūn va aʿṣār bih awhām tarbiyat shudih-and. ʿUyūn-i marmūdih lāyiq-i mushāhadih-yi anvār-i āftāb nah; nufūs-i mawhūmih qābil-i tajalliyāt-i nayyir-i yaqīn nah. Mabdaʾuhum al-ẓunūn wa muntahāhum al-awhām. Kadhālika naṭaqa lisānu [corrupted text] al-ʿAzīz al-ʿAllām. Intahā. Dhikr-i Jināb-i Āqā Sayyid Faraju’llāh, ʿalayhi 9 66 [bahāʾu Allāh], az qalam-i ān maḥbūb jārī. Baʿd az ʿarḍ ladā al-ʿarsh nayyir-i īn bayān az ufuq-i samā-yi burhān mushriq.

“O servant in attendance! Even now it is not possible to speak of the manifest Truth. Despite the sound of the Most Exalted Pen and the call of the Master of Names, no true hearing or sight has been seen. He is deemed unworthy to be beheld and undeserving to be heard. Consider the people of the Bayān: although the error, waywardness, and loss of the Shīʿih community are plain and evident, they are once again engaged in forming such a community. By the life of God, that community has not perceived the fragrance of divine unity. They have been, and remain, worshippers of idols and vain imaginings. Until now, God has spoken with restraint, for the servants are weak. Over centuries and ages they have been brought up on vain imaginings. Inflamed eyes are unfit to behold the sun’s rays; deluded souls are incapable of receiving the effulgences of the luminary of certitude. Their beginning is conjecture, and their end is vain imaginings. Thus has spoken the tongue of [corrupted original text], the Almighty, the All-Knowing.” Here it ends. The mention of Jināb-i Āqā Sayyid Faraju’llāh—upon him be 9 66 [the glory of God]—flowed from that beloved one’s pen. After it was presented before the throne, the luminary of this utterance shone from the horizon of the heaven of proof:

108

یا فرج علیک بهائی ذکرت مذکور و اسمت مسطور دیدیم و شنیدیم و باین بیان در ملکوت برهان نطق فرمودیم این ایّام مکرّر ذکرت از قلم اعلی جاری اشکر ربّک از حقّ بطلب ترا تأیید فرماید بر ذکر و ثنا و ترویج امر انّه علی کلّشیء قدیر اهل آن ارض را از قبل مظلوم تکبیر برسان و بما ینبغی لأیّام اللّه متذکّر دار انتهی

Yā Faraj, ʿalayka bahāʾī. Dhikrat madhkūr va ismat masṭūr. Dīdīm va shinīdīm va bih īn bayān dar malakūt-i burhān nuṭq farmūdīm. Īn ayyām mukarrar dhikrat az Qalam-i Aʿlā jārī. Ushkur rabbak. Az Ḥaqq biṭalab turā taʾyīd farmāyad bar dhikr va thanā va tarvīj-i Amr. Innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Ahl-i ān arḍ rā az qibal-i Maẓlūm takbīr birasān va bi-mā yanbaghī li-ayyāmi Allāh mutadhakkir dār. Intahā.

“O Faraj! Upon you be My glory. Your mention is remembered and your name recorded. We saw and heard, and spoke this utterance in the kingdom of proof. In these days your mention has repeatedly flowed from the Most Exalted Pen. Thank your Lord. Ask God to confirm you in remembrance, praise, and the promotion of the Cause. He indeed has power over all things. Convey greetings to the people of that land on behalf of the Wronged One, and remind them of what befits the days of God.” Here it ends.

109

و همچنین ذکر جناب آقا میرزا آقا ش علیه بهآء اللّه نمودند بعد از عرض این آیات نازل قوله تبارک و تعالی شماتت اعدا و ظلم اشقیا و بلایای دنیا کلّ را لأجل خلاص عالم قبول نمودیم و حمل فرمودیم ولکن کلّ غافل الّا من شآء اللّه انّک احمد ربّک بما ایّدک و علّمک و عرّفک و سقّاک کوثر العرفان من ایادی الفضل و العطآء نسأله بأن یوفّقک علی الاستقامة علی امره المبرم المتین انتهی

Va hamchunīn dhikr-i Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Āqā Sh, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, namūdand. Baʿd az ʿarḍ īn āyāt nāzil, qawluhu tabāraka wa taʿālā. Shamātat-i aʿdā va ẓulm-i ashqiyā va balāyā-yi dunyā, kull rā li-ajl-i khalāṣ-i ʿālam qabūl namūdīm va ḥaml farmūdīm, va lākin kull ghāfil illā man shāʾa Allāh. Innaka iḥmad rabbaka bi-mā ayyadaka wa ʿallamaka wa ʿarrafaka wa saqāka Kawthara al-ʿirfān min ayādī al-faḍli wa al-ʿaṭāʾ. Nasʾaluhu bi-an yuwaffiqaka ʿalā al-istiqāmati ʿalā amrihi al-mubrami al-matīn. Intahā.

You also mentioned Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Āqā Sh—may the glory of God rest upon him. After this was presented, these verses were revealed. These are His words, blessed and exalted is He: “The gloating of enemies, the oppression of the wicked, and the afflictions of the world: We accepted and bore them all for the deliverance of the world. Yet all are heedless except those whom God wills. Praise your Lord for having confirmed you, taught you, granted you recognition, and given you to drink of the Kawthar of recognition from the hands of grace and bounty. We ask Him to enable you to remain steadfast in His irrevocable, firm Cause.” Here it ends.

110

از توجّه جناب آقا میرزا مجید علیه بهآء اللّه بآنجهت و همچنین استقامت و اشتعال ایشان ذکر فرمودند بعد از عرض در ساحت اقدس اینکلمات نازل قوله تبارک و تعالی

Az tavajjuh-i Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Majīd, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, bih ān jihat va hamchunīn istiqāmat va ishtiʿāl-i īshān dhikr farmūdand. Baʿd az ʿarḍ dar sāḥat-i aqdas īn kalimāt nāzil, qawluhu tabāraka wa taʿālā.

You mentioned Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Majīd’s journey in that direction—may the glory of God rest upon him—as well as his steadfastness and ardor. After this was presented in the Most Holy Court, these words were revealed. These are His words, blessed and exalted is He:

111

یا مجید عالم را اوهام اخذ نموده و اسباب نزاع و فساد از هر شطری مشهود در این قرن عالم جرائد را رونقی پدیدار و صاحبان آن آنرا علّت عمار عالم و تربیت امم و ترقّی و تهذیب و دانائی و آگاهی عباد میدانند فی‌الحقیقه اسباب حشر و نشر است یوم تحدّث الأرض اخبارها مشهود و مسموع و الأرض جمیعاً قبضته یوم القیامة ظاهر و آشکار ارض در سرّ حدیثهای بدیعهٴ منیعه دارد و باخبارهای جدیده و عتیقه ناطق و در ظاهر هم طیر اخبار بکلّ جهات طائر ولکن اسف در اینکه بعضی از جرائد اخبارات مجعوله را هم من‌غیر تحقیق نشر مینمایند هر نفسی آنچه بگوید میگویند و آنچه بنگارد مینگارند چنانچه مطالع اوهام بجرائد اوهامات خود را نشر مینمایند یا مجید در یوم تأتی السّمآء بدخان مبین تفکّر نما این ایّام کذب را رونق عظیمی است غبار اوهام انام را از مالک ایّام منع نموده از حقّ میطلبیم نفوسی برانگیزاند بحقّ نطق نمایند و سد و صدّ عباد ایشانرا از یوم معاد محروم نسازد طوبی لمن سمع ندائی و قام علی خدمتی و خدمة اولیائی و نطق بثنائی الجمیل الحمد للّه الفرد الواحد العزیز الجمیل انتهی

Yā Majīd, ʿālam rā awhām akhdh namūdeh va asbāb-i nizāʿ va fasād az har shaṭrī mashhūd. Dar īn qarn-i ʿālam jarāʾid rā rawnaqī padīdār va ṣāḥibān-i ān ān rā ʿillat-i ʿimār-i ʿālam va tarbiyat-i umam va taraqqī va tahdhīb va dānāʾī va āgāhī-yi ʿibād mīdānand. Fī-l-ḥaqīqeh asbāb-i ḥashr va nashr ast. Yawma tuḥaddithu al-arḍu akhbārahā mashhūd va masmūʿ, va-l-arḍu jamīʿan qabḍatuhu yawma al-qiyāmah ẓāhir va āshkār. Arḍ dar sirr ḥadīthhā-yi badīʿeh-yi manīʿeh dārad va bi-akhbārhā-yi jadīdeh va ʿatīqeh nāṭiq va dar ẓāhir ham ṭayr-i akhbār bi-kull-i jihāt ṭāʾir. Va-lākin asaf dar īnkih baʿḍī az jarāʾid akhbārāt-i majʿūleh rā ham min ghayr-i taḥqīq nashr mīnamāyand. Har nafsī ānchih bigūyad mīgūyand va ānchih bingārad mīngārand, chunānchih maṭāliʿ-i awhām bi-jarāʾid awhāmāt-i khud rā nashr mīnamāyand. Yā Majīd, dar yawma taʾtī al-samāʾu bi-dukhānin mubīn tafakkur namā. Īn ayyām kidhb rā rawnaq-i ʿaẓīmī ast. Ghubār-i awhām anām rā az Mālik-i Ayyām manʿ namūdeh. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm nufūsī bar-angīzānad bi-ḥaqq nuṭq namāyand va sadd va ṣadd-i ʿibād īshān rā az Yawm-i Maʿād maḥrūm nasāzad. Ṭūbā li-man samiʿa nidāʾī wa qāma ʿalā khidmatī wa khidmati awliyāʾī wa naṭaqa bi-thanāʾī al-jamīl. Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi al-Fardi al-Wāḥidi al-ʿAzīzi al-Jamīl. Intahā.

O Majīd, delusions have seized the world, and causes of conflict and disorder are evident on every side. In this century, newspapers have gained prominence in the world, and their proprietors regard them as a means of building up the world, educating the nations, and advancing, refining, informing, and enlightening its people. They are, in truth, instruments of gathering and dissemination. “The day when the earth recounts its tidings” is seen and heard, and “the entire earth will be in His grasp on the Day of Resurrection” is plain and manifest. In secret, the earth has wondrous and sublime accounts to tell and speaks of tidings new and old; outwardly, too, the bird of news flies in every direction. Yet it is regrettable that some newspapers also publish fabricated reports without investigation. Whatever anyone says, they repeat, and whatever anyone writes, they reproduce. Thus, those who are the sources of delusions disseminate their imaginings through newspapers. O Majīd, reflect on “the day when the sky brings forth a manifest smoke.” In these days, falsehood flourishes greatly. The dust of delusions has kept the people from the Lord of Days. We ask God to raise up souls who will speak the truth and whom the barriers and opposition of the people will not deprive of the Day of Return. Blessed is anyone who has heard My call, arisen to serve Me and My loved ones, and voiced My beautiful praise. Praise be to God, the Unique, the One, the Almighty, the All-Beauteous. Here it ends.

112

فی‌الحقیقه جراید گاهی طیّ الأرض مینمایند و هنگامی بقوادم اخبار در طیران و وقتی تغییر اسم مینمایند و سیّالهٴ برقیّه میشود تتطایر منها الأذکار و الأخبار و الآثار ولکن از حقّ جلّ جلاله مسئلت مینمایم صاحبان آنرا تأیید فرماید تا کلّ بآنچه سزاوار است عمل نمایند گمان نمیرفت که بعضی از جرائد اروپا من‌غیر تحقیق ذکری نماید و یا تابع گفتهای مجعولهٴ عباد شود مظاهر اوهام در لیالی و ایّام بجراید مکتوب میفرستند و من‌غیر تحقیق طبع میشود چون بعضی طالب اخبار تازه هستند طبع مینمایند از حقّ میطلبم کلّ را تأیید فرماید علی العمل بقوله تعالی لا تصدّقوا کلّ قائل و لا تطمئنّوا من کلّ وارد مکرّر از هر محل بعضی از نفوس اراده نموده‌اند شرحی نوشته و ارسال شود تا در کتب و جرائد نشر نمایند مقبول نیفتاد الی حین کلمه داده نشد الأمر بیده یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید و هو العزیز الحمید

Fī-l-ḥaqīqeh jarāyid gāhī ṭayy-i arḍ mīnamāyand va hangāmī bi-qawādim-i akhbār dar ṭayarān va vaqtī taghyīr-i ism mīnamāyand va sayyāleh-yi barqiyyeh mīshavad. Tataṭāyaru minhā al-adhkāru wa-l-akhbāru wa-l-āthār. Va-lākin az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu masʾalat mīnamāyam ṣāḥibān-i ān rā taʾyīd farmāyad tā kull bi-ānchih sazāvār ast ʿamal namāyand. Gumān namīraft kih baʿḍī az jarāʾid-i Urūpā min ghayr-i taḥqīq dhikrī namāyad va yā tābiʿ-i guftahā-yi majʿūleh-yi ʿibād shavad. Maẓāhir-i awhām dar layālī va ayyām bi-jarāyid maktūb mīfiristand va min ghayr-i taḥqīq ṭabʿ mīshavad. Chūn baʿḍī ṭālib-i akhbār-i tāzeh hastand ṭabʿ mīnamāyand. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabam kull rā taʾyīd farmāyad ʿalā al-ʿamali bi-qawlihi taʿālā lā tuṣaddiqū kulla qāʾilin wa lā taṭmaʾinnū min kulli wārid. Mukarrar az har maḥall baʿḍī az nufūs irādeh namūdeh-and sharḥī nivishteh va irsāl shavad tā dar kutub va jarāʾid nashr namāyand. Maqbūl nayuftād. Ilā ḥīn kalameh dādeh nashud. Al-amru bi-yadihi yafʿalu mā yashāʾu wa yaḥkumu mā yurīdu wa huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-Ḥamīd.

Indeed, newspapers sometimes traverse the earth, sometimes fly on the pinions of news, and sometimes change their name and become an electric current. From it, accounts, reports, and writings fly forth. Yet I beseech God, exalted be His glory, to assist their proprietors, so that all may act as is fitting. It was not expected that some European newspapers would make statements without investigation or follow the fabricated accounts of individuals. Day and night, the embodiments of delusion send letters to newspapers, and these are printed without investigation. Since some are eager for fresh news, they print them. I ask God to assist everyone to act according to His exalted words: “Do not believe every speaker, nor place your trust in every report that arrives.” Repeatedly, certain individuals in various places have wished that an account be written and sent so that they might publish it in books and newspapers. This was not accepted. To this day, no word has been given. The matter is in His hands. He does what He wills and ordains what He desires, and He is the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

113

در بارهٴ رضائین مرقوم داشتند بعد از عرض یک لوح امنع اقدس مخصوص جناب آقا محمّد رضای میلانی علیه بهآء اللّه از سماء عنایت الهی نازل و ارسال شد فرمودند هذا افضل من الاذن و انا الفضّال الکریم مخصوص جناب آقا میرزا حسن علیه بهآء اللّه که مرقوم داشتند یک لوح امنع اقدس نازل و ارسال شد از حقّ میطلبم ایشان را موفّق فرماید بر حفظ این عنایت کبری انّه هو المجیب

Dar bāreh-yi Riḍāyayn marqūm dāshtand. Baʿd az ʿarḍ, yik lawḥ-i amnaʿ-i aqdas makhṣūṣ-i Jināb-i Āqā Muḥammad-Riḍā-yi Mīlānī ʿalayhi Bahāʾuʾllāh az samāʾ-i ʿināyat-i ilāhī nāzil va irsāl shud. Farmūdand hādhā afḍalu mina al-idhni wa anā al-Faḍḍālu al-Karīm. Makhṣūṣ-i Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Ḥasan ʿalayhi Bahāʾuʾllāh kih marqūm dāshtand yik lawḥ-i amnaʿ-i aqdas nāzil va irsāl shud. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabam īshān rā muvaffaq farmāyad bar ḥifẓ-i īn ʿināyat-i kubrā. Innahu huwa al-Mujīb.

You wrote concerning the two Riḍās. After this was presented, a most exalted, most holy Tablet was revealed from the heaven of divine favor specifically for Jināb-i Āqā Muḥammad-Riḍā Mīlānī—may the glory of God rest upon him—and was sent. He said: “This is better than permission, and I am the Most Bountiful, the Generous.” A most exalted, most holy Tablet was also revealed and sent specifically for Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Ḥasan—may the glory of God rest upon him—whom you mentioned. I ask God to enable him to preserve this supreme favor. He is indeed the Answerer.

114

در بارهٴ ابن جناب مرحوم آقا میرزا ع ب علیه بهآء اللّه آنچه مرقوم داشتند ملاحظه شد بعد از عرض در ساحت اقدس فرمودند لوحی در بارهٴ او نازل اگر مقتضی است برسانند والّا فلا ولکن آنمحبوب باید بسیار بحکمت حرکت فرمایند چه که امثال آن نفوس را اگر انسان پند بگوید و یا نصیحت نماید همان کلمه سبب بغضا شود و سبب فساد گردد

Dar bāreh-yi ibn-i Jināb-i marḥūm Āqā Mīrzā ʿ B ʿalayhi Bahāʾuʾllāh ānchih marqūm dāshtand mulāḥaẓeh shud. Baʿd az ʿarḍ dar sāḥat-i aqdas farmūdand lawḥī dar bāreh-yi ū nāzil, agar muqtaḍī ast birasānand va illā fa-lā. Va-lākin ān maḥbūb bāyad bisyār bi-ḥikmat ḥarakat farmāyand, chih kih amthāl-i ān nufūs rā agar insān pand bigūyad va yā naṣīḥat namāyad hamān kalameh sabab-i baghḍā shavad va sabab-i fasād gardad.

What you wrote concerning the son of the late Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā ʿ. B.—may the glory of God rest upon him—was read. After it was presented in the Most Holy Court, He said: “A Tablet has been revealed concerning him. If it is appropriate, let them deliver it; otherwise, no.” That beloved one, however, must act with great wisdom, for if one offers counsel or advice to people of that kind, those very words become a cause of hatred and disorder.

115

آنچه در آخر این نامه از خضوع و خشوع و ابتهال و مناجات با حقّ جلّ جلاله ذکر شده بود بشرف اصغا فائز قوله تبارک و تعالی انّا سمعنا منک ما ینبغی لساحة عزّی و عرش کبریائی طوبی للسانک انّه نطق بما تضوّع منه عرف عنایتی و فضلی و رحمتی و لعینک بما شهدت و رأت و لأذنک بما سمعت ندآء اللّه النّاطق العلیم الحکیم قد فاز بالقبول توجّهک و حضورک و اقبالک و ابتهالک فی ایّام اللّه ربّ العالمین نسأل اللّه ان یمدّک و یؤیّدک علی نشر امره و اعلآء کلمته و انتشار احکامه انّه علی کلّشیء قدیر انتهی

Ānchih dar ākhir-i īn nāmeh az khuḍūʿ va khushūʿ va ibtihāl va munājāt bā Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu dhikr shudeh būd bi-sharaf-i iṣghā fāʾiz. Qawluhu tabāraka wa taʿālā innā samiʿnā minka mā yanbaghī li-sāḥati ʿizzī wa ʿarshi kibriyāʾī. Ṭūbā li-lisānika innahu naṭaqa bi-mā taḍawwaʿa minhu ʿarfu ʿināyatī wa faḍlī wa raḥmatī wa li-ʿaynika bi-mā shahidat wa raʾat wa li-udhunika bi-mā samiʿat nidāʾa Allāhi al-Nāṭiqi al-ʿAlīmi al-Ḥakīm. Qad fāza bi-l-qabūli tawajjuhuka wa ḥuḍūruka wa iqbāluka wa ibtihāluka fī ayyāmi Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Nasʾalu Allāha an yumiddaka wa yuʾayyidaka ʿalā nashri amrihi wa iʿlāʾi kalimatihi wa intishāri aḥkāmihi innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Intahā.

What was mentioned at the end of this letter concerning humility, submissiveness, supplication, and prayer to God, exalted be His glory, attained the honor of being heard. These are His words, blessed and exalted is He: “We have heard from you what befits the court of My might and the throne of My grandeur. Blessed is your tongue, for it spoke words from which the fragrance of My favor, My bounty, and My mercy spread; and blessed is your eye for what it witnessed and saw, and your ear for having heard the call of God, the Speaker, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Your turning toward Me, your presence, your devotion, and your supplication have been accepted in the days of God, the Lord of the worlds. We ask God to aid and confirm you in spreading His Cause, exalting His Word, and disseminating His laws. He has power over all things.” Here it ends.

116

بعد از عرض مناجات و مراتب خضوع و ابتهال آنمحبوب فرات رحمت جاری و آفتاب عنایت از افق سماء فضل مشرق بشأنی بحر بیان رحمن موّاج که اینعبد فانی از ذکرش عاجز و قاصر از بدایع فضلش میطلبیم رشحی از این فضل بر عالمیان مبذول فرماید تا کلّ فائز شوند بآنچه که سبب بقاء ابدی و حیوة سرمدیست

Baʿd az ʿarḍ-i munājāt va marātib-i khuḍūʿ va ibtihāl-i ān maḥbūb, Furāt-i raḥmat jārī va āftāb-i ʿināyat az ufuq-i samāʾ-i faḍl mushriq. Bi-shaʾnī baḥr-i bayān-i Raḥmān mavvāj kih īn ʿabd-i fānī az dhikrash ʿājiz va qāṣir. Az badāyiʿ-i faḍlash mīṭalabīm rashḥī az īn faḍl bar ʿālamiyān mabdhūl farmāyad tā kull fāʾiz shavand bi-ānchih kih sabab-i baqā-yi abadī va ḥayāt-i sarmadīst.

After that beloved one’s prayer and expressions of humility and supplication were presented, the Euphrates of mercy flowed and the sun of loving-kindness shone from the horizon of the heaven of bounty. The ocean of the All-Merciful’s utterance surged to such a degree that this evanescent servant is powerless and unable to describe it. We ask, through the wonders of His bounty, that He bestow a sprinkling of this grace upon the people of the world, so that all may attain what brings everlasting existence and eternal life.

117

در دستخطّ دیگر آنمحبوب بعد از مراتب ذکر و ثنا و ارتقاء بسماء عرفان مالک اسماء ذکر حبیب روحانی جناب نوری علیه بهآء اللّه الأبهی را نمودند و همچنین فقرات مذکورهٴ ایشانرا مرقوم داشتند بعد از عرض حضور لسان عظمت باین آیات ناطق قوله تبارک و تعالی

Dar dastkhaṭṭ-i dīgar-i ān maḥbūb baʿd az marātib-i dhikr va thanā va irtiqā bi-samāʾ-i ʿirfān-i Mālik-i Asmāʾ dhikr-i ḥabīb-i rūḥānī Jināb-i Nūrī ʿalayhi Bahāʾuʾllāhi al-Abhā rā namūdand va hamchunīn faqarāt-i madhkūreh-yi īshān rā marqūm dāshtand. Baʿd az ʿarḍ-i ḥuḍūr lisān-i ʿaẓamat bi-īn āyāt nāṭiq. Qawluhu tabāraka wa taʿālā.

In that beloved one’s other letter, after expressions of remembrance and praise and ascent to the heaven of recognition of the Lord of Names, you mentioned the spiritual friend Jināb-i Nūrī—may the glory of God, the All-Glorious, rest upon him—and also set down the passages he had mentioned. After this was presented in His presence, the Tongue of Grandeur spoke these verses. These are His words, blessed and exalted is He:

118

ع ب لازال مذکور بوده و هستی ذکرش ذکرت تعلیم نمود عنایتش یدت را اخذ فرمود رحمتش راه نمود و فضلش احاطه فرمود دانش عطا کرد بینش بخشید مدد فرمود تأیید نمود للّه الحمد فائز شدی بآنچه که شبه از برای او نبوده و نیست در جمیع نامه‌های ورقا علیه بهائی و عنایتی ذکرت بوده نسأله تعالی بأن یمدّک و یؤیّدک علی ما یحبّ و یرضی و یقدّر لک ما یکون نوراً امام وجهک فی کلّ عالم من عوالمه انّه علی کلّشیء قدیر انتهی

ʿ B, lāzāl madhkūr būdeh va hastī. Dhikrash dhikrat taʿlīm namūd. ʿInāyatash yadat rā akhdh farmūd. Raḥmatash rāh numūd va faḍlash iḥāṭeh farmūd. Dānish ʿaṭā kard, bīnish bakhshīd, madad farmūd, taʾyīd namūd. Li-llāhi al-ḥamd fāʾiz shudī bi-ānchih kih shibh az barā-yi ū nabūdeh va nīst. Dar jamīʿ-i nāmehā-yi Varqā ʿalayhi bahāʾī va ʿināyatī dhikrat būdeh. Nasʾaluhu taʿālā bi-an yumiddaka wa yuʾayyidaka ʿalā mā yuḥibbu wa yarḍā wa yuqaddira laka mā yakūnu nūran amāma wajhika fī kulli ʿālamin min ʿawālimihi innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Intahā.

“ʿ. B., you have always been and remain remembered. His remembrance taught you to remember Him. His loving-kindness took you by the hand. His mercy showed you the way, and His bounty encompassed you. He granted knowledge, bestowed insight, gave assistance, and lent support. Praise be to God, you have attained what has never had and has no equal. You have been mentioned in all the letters of Varqā—upon him be My glory and My loving-kindness. We ask Him, exalted is He, to aid and confirm you in what He loves and approves, and to ordain for you what will be a light before your face in every one of His worlds. He has power over all things.” Here it ends.

119

خبر ایشان و صحّت و سلامتی پی در پی از ارض طا رسیده احبّای آن ارض ذکر خیر ایشانرا مکرّر نموده‌اند فی‌الحقیقه بحقّ ناطقند و بخدمت قائم ذکر جناب اخوی آقا میرزا حسین علیه بهآء اللّه را نمودند بعد از عرض در ساحت اقدس این آیات از ملکوت بیان رحمن نازل

Khabar-i īshān va ṣiḥḥat va salāmatī pay dar pay az Arḍ-i Ṭā risīdeh. Aḥibbā-yi ān arḍ dhikr-i khayr-i īshān rā mukarrar namūdeh-and. Fī-l-ḥaqīqeh bi-ḥaqq nāṭiqand va bi-khidmat qāʾim. Dhikr-i Jināb-i akhavī Āqā Mīrzā Ḥusayn ʿalayhi Bahāʾuʾllāh rā namūdand. Baʿd az ʿarḍ dar sāḥat-i aqdas īn āyāt az malakūt-i bayān-i Raḥmān nāzil.

News of him and of his health and well-being has arrived repeatedly from the Land of Ṭā. The friends in that land have often spoken well of him. In truth, he speaks the truth and is engaged in service. You mentioned your honored brother, Āqā Mīrzā Ḥusayn—may the glory of God rest upon him. After this was presented in the Most Holy Court, these verses were revealed from the kingdom of the All-Merciful’s utterance:

120

قول الرّبّ تعالی و تقدّس یا حسین علیک بهائی انشآءاللّه فائز شوی بآنچه که سزاوار است و از نهالهای باثمر باشی که ظهوراتش در ایّام الهی ظاهر شود حقّ بید عنایت نهالهای جدیده کشته و بآب عنایت سقایه فرموده که شاید ثمر دهند و سایه بخشند طوبی لمن فاز بهذا المقام الأسنی قل یا اله الأسمآء لک الحمد بما شرّفتنی و اریتنی و اسمعتنی اسألک بأن تؤیّدنی علی ما تحبّ و ترضی انّک انت مولی الوری و ربّ الآخرة و الأولی انتهی

Qawlu al-Rabbi taʿālā wa taqaddas. Yā Ḥusayn, ʿalayka bahāʾī. In shāʾ Allāh fāʾiz shavī bi-ānchih kih sazāvār ast va az nihālhā-yi bā-thamar bāshī kih ẓuhūrātash dar ayyām-i ilāhī ẓāhir shavad. Ḥaqq bi-yad-i ʿināyat nihālhā-yi jadīdeh kishteh va bi-āb-i ʿināyat siqāyeh farmūdeh kih shāyad thamar dihand va sāyeh bakhshand. Ṭūbā li-man fāza bi-hādhā al-maqāmi al-asnā. Qul yā Ilāha al-Asmāʾ laka al-ḥamdu bi-mā sharraftanī wa araytanī wa asmaʿtanī. Asʾaluka bi-an tuʾayyidanī ʿalā mā tuḥibbu wa tarḍā innaka anta Mawlā al-warā wa Rabbu al-ākhirati wa-l-ūlā. Intahā.

The words of the Lord, exalted and sanctified is He: “O Ḥusayn, upon you be My glory. God willing, may you attain what is fitting and be among the fruitful saplings whose growth becomes manifest in the divine days. God has planted new saplings with the hand of loving-kindness and watered them with the water of His favor, that they may bear fruit and give shade. Blessed is anyone who attains this most exalted station. Say: ‘O God of Names, praise be to You for having honored me, enabled me to see, and enabled me to hear. I ask You to confirm me in what You love and approve. You are the Lord of all creation and the Lord of the world to come and of this world.’” Here it ends.

121

اینعبد هم خدمت ایشان سلام و تکبیر میرساند و از حقّ توفیق و تأیید میطلبد اینکه در بارهٴ جناب استاد حسین علیه ٩ ٦٦ [بهآء الله] مرقوم داشتند که تازه بشریعهٴ عرفان وارد شده بعد فوز ذکره باصغاء مولی الوری نیّر فضل از افق ملکوت بیان مشرق و این آیات نازل قوله جلّ جلاله و عمّ نواله

Īn ʿabd ham khidmat-i īshān salām va takbīr mīrasānad va az Ḥaqq tawfīq va taʾyīd mīṭalabad. Īnkih dar bāreh-yi Jināb-i Ustād Ḥusayn ʿalayhi 9 66 [Bahāʾuʾllāh] marqūm dāshtand kih tāzeh bi-sharīʿeh-yi ʿirfān vārid shudeh, baʿda fawzi dhikrihi bi-iṣghāʾi Mawlā al-warā nayyir-i faḍl az ufuq-i malakūt-i bayān mushriq va īn āyāt nāzil. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa ʿamma nawāluhu.

This servant also conveys greetings and praise to him and asks God to grant him success and support. Concerning what you wrote about Jināb-i Ustād Ḥusayn—upon him be 9 66 [the glory of God]—that he has newly reached the water’s edge of recognition: after the mention of him attained the hearing of the Lord of all creation, the luminary of bounty shone from the horizon of the kingdom of utterance, and these verses were revealed. These are His words, exalted be His glory and all-embracing His bounty:

122

احمد اللّه بما ایّدک علی الاقبال فی یوم اخذ فیه الدّخان سکّان الأرض و علّمک اذ کان العباد علی جهل مبین قل لک البهآء یا مولی الأسماء و لک العنایة یا مولی البریّه بما ایّدتنی علی عرفان بحر بیانک و سمآء عطائک و نوّرتنی بأنوار شمس ظهورک ای ربّ ایّدنی علی الاستقامة علی امرک ثمّ وفّقنی علی ذکرک و ثنائک انّک انت المقتدر العزیز القدیر و بالاجابة جدیر انتهی

Iḥmadi Allāha bi-mā ayyadaka ʿalā al-iqbāli fī yawmin akhadha fīhi al-dukhānu sukkāna al-arḍi wa ʿallamaka idh kāna al-ʿibādu ʿalā jahlin mubīn. Qul laka al-bahāʾu yā Mawlā al-Asmāʾ wa laka al-ʿināyatu yā Mawlā al-bariyyah bi-mā ayyadtanī ʿalā ʿirfāni baḥri bayānika wa samāʾi ʿaṭāʾika wa nawwartanī bi-anwāri shamsi ẓuhūrika. Ay Rabbi ayyidnī ʿalā al-istiqāmati ʿalā amrika thumma waffiqnī ʿalā dhikrika wa thanāʾika innaka anta al-Muqtadiru al-ʿAzīzu al-Qadīru wa bi-l-ijābati jadīr. Intahā.

“Praise God for having enabled you to turn toward Him on a day when smoke has enveloped the inhabitants of the earth, and for having taught you when the people were in manifest ignorance. Say: ‘Yours is the glory, O Lord of Names, and Yours is the loving-kindness, O Lord of creation, for having enabled me to recognize the ocean of Your utterance and the heaven of Your bounty, and for having illumined me with the rays of the sun of Your revelation. O Lord, confirm me in steadfastness in Your Cause, and enable me to remember and praise You. You are the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent, and worthy to answer prayers.’” Here it ends.

123

و اینکلمات درّیّات از مشرق ارادهٴ مولی الأسمآء و الصّفات مخصوص دو ابن جناب ملّا مصطفی و آقا غلامحسین علیهم بهآء اللّه نازل قول الرّب تعالی و تقدّس

Va īn kalimāt-i durriyyāt az mashriq-i irādeh-yi Mawlā al-Asmāʾ wa-l-Ṣifāt makhṣūṣ-i du ibn-i Jināb-i Mullā Muṣṭafā va Āqā Ghulām-Ḥusayn ʿalayhim Bahāʾuʾllāh nāzil. Qawlu al-Rabbi taʿālā wa taqaddas.

And these pearl-like words were revealed from the dawning-place of the will of the Lord of Names and Attributes specifically for the two sons of Jināb-i Mullā Muṣṭafā and Āqā Ghulām-Ḥusayn—may the glory of God rest upon them. The words of the Lord, exalted and sanctified is He:

124

یا ابنآء الانسان جهد نمائید از شما ظاهر شود آنچه لایق ایّام الهی است اینمظلوم شما را وصیّت میفرماید بآنچه که سبب علوّ و سموّ است زیّنوا هیاکلکم بطراز الأعمال و رؤوسکم باکلیل الأخلاق لتستضیء بهما الآفاق نور ظاهر و مشرق و نیّر امر مشهود و لائح دیوان یعنی نفوس غافله در کمین انسان بوده و هستند خود را باسم حقّ حفظ نمائید آگاه باشید بیدار باشید اینست وصیّت او طوبی للعاملین انتهی

Yā abnāʾa al-insān, jahd namāyīd az shumā ẓāhir shavad ānchih lāyiq-i ayyām-i ilāhī ast. Īn Maẓlūm shumā rā vaṣiyyat mīfarmāyad bi-ānchih kih sabab-i ʿuluvv va sumuvv ast. Zayyinū hayākilakum bi-ṭirāzi al-aʿmāli wa ruʾūsakum bi-iklīli al-akhlāqi li-tastaḍīʾa bi-himā al-āfāq. Nūr ẓāhir va mushriq va nayyir-i amr mashhūd va lāʾiḥ. Dīvān yaʿnī nufūs-i ghāfileh dar kamīn-i insān būdeh va hastand. Khud rā bi-ism-i Ḥaqq ḥifẓ namāyīd. Āgāh bāshīd, bīdār bāshīd. Īnast vaṣiyyat-i ū. Ṭūbā li-l-ʿāmilīn. Intahā.

“O children of humanity, strive to manifest what befits the divine days. This Wronged One counsels you to do what will bring exaltation and elevation. Adorn your persons with the ornament of deeds and your heads with the crown of good character, so that the world may be illumined by them both. The light is manifest and shining, and the luminary of the Cause is visible and radiant. Demons—that is, heedless souls—have always lain and still lie in wait for human beings. Protect yourselves through the name of God. Be aware; be watchful. This is His counsel. Blessed are those who act upon it.” Here it ends.

125

شکر مقصود عالم را عنایتش کلّ را شامل نیسان رحمتش لازال بر اراضی قلوب من‌غیر توقّف هاطل و نازل جودش وجود را احاطه نموده و فضلش عطا فرموده آنچه را که شبه و مثل نداشته ولکن آنمحبوب فؤاد و اینعبد باید از حقّ جلّ جلاله بطلبیم تا حجبات مانعه را خرق فرماید شاید ببینند و بشناسند اینکه در بارهٴ مخدّرهٴ مرفوعه امّ حبیبان جناب آقا میرزا سلیمان و جناب آقا میرزا مهدی علیها و علیهما بهآء اللّه ذکر نمودند بعد از عرض در پیشگاه حضور اینکلمات عالیات از مطلع ارادهٴ حقّ جلّ جلاله نازل و ظاهر قوله جلّ بیانه و جلّ برهانه

Shukr-i Maqṣūd-i ʿālam rā. ʿInāyatash kull rā shāmil. Naysān-i raḥmatash lāzāl bar arāḍī-yi qulūb min ghayr-i tavaqquf hāṭil va nāzil. Jūdash vujūd rā iḥāṭeh namūdeh va faḍlash ʿaṭā farmūdeh ānchih rā kih shibh va mithl nadāshteh. Va-lākin ān maḥbūb-i fuʾād va īn ʿabd bāyad az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu biṭalabīm tā ḥujubāt-i māniʿeh rā kharq farmāyad, shāyad bibīnand va bishināsand. Īnkih dar bāreh-yi mukhaddareh-yi marfūʿeh umm-i ḥabībayn Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Sulaymān va Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Mahdī ʿalayhā wa ʿalayhimā Bahāʾuʾllāh dhikr namūdand, baʿd az ʿarḍ dar pīshgāh-i ḥuḍūr īn kalimāt-i ʿāliyāt az maṭlaʿ-i irādeh-yi Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu nāzil va ẓāhir. Qawluhu jalla bayānuhu wa jalla burhānuhu.

Thanks be to the Desire of the world. His loving-kindness embraces everyone. The spring rain of His mercy has always fallen ceaselessly upon the soil of hearts. His generosity has encompassed existence, and His bounty has bestowed what has had neither equal nor likeness. Yet that beloved of the heart and this servant must ask God, exalted be His glory, to rend the obstructing veils, that perhaps they may see and recognize. Concerning your mention of the exalted lady, the mother of the two dear ones, Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Sulaymān and Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Mahdī—may the glory of God rest upon her and upon them both—after this was presented in His presence, these exalted words were revealed and made manifest from the dawning-place of the will of God, exalted be His glory. These are His words, exalted be His utterance and exalted His proof:

126

یا قلم اذکر الورقة الّتی خرجت من دیارها مقبلة الی الأفق الأعلی لتحضر امام الوجه و تقوم لدی الباب و تسمع ندآء المظلوم و تری افق الظّهور اشهد انّها سمعت ندآء ربّها و آمنت به و اقبلت الیه و شهدت بما شهد به لسان العظمة طوبی لک یا امتی و یا ورقتی انت الّتی فزت بذکری قبل صعودک و بعده طوبی لک بما فزت بأیّام اللّه و آثاره فی یوم فیه اعرضن امآء الأرض و ملکاتها انّا وجدنا منک عرف حبّی و التّوجّه الی انوار وجهی نسأل اللّه تعالی ان یدخلک فی الفردوس الأعلی و یزیّنک بالاکلیل المزیّنة باسمه الأبهی و ینزل علیک فیکلّ حین رحمة من عنده و نوراً من لدنه انّه هو المقتدر الغفور الکریم البهآء من لدنّا علیک و علی الامآء اللّائی یذکرنک بما نطق القلم الأعلی فی هذه اللّیلة الدّلمآء انتهی

Yā qalam, udhkur al-waraqata allatī kharajat min diyārihā muqbilatan ilā al-ufuq al-aʿlā li-taḥḍura amāma al-wajh wa-taqūma ladā al-bāb wa-tasmaʿa nidāʾ al-Maẓlūm wa-tarā ufuq al-ẓuhūr. Ashhadu annahā samiʿat nidāʾ rabbihā wa-āmanat bihi wa-aqbalat ilayhi wa-shahidat bimā shahida bihi lisān al-ʿaẓama. Ṭūbā laki yā amatī wa-yā waraqatī, anti allatī fuzti bi-dhikrī qabla ṣuʿūdiki wa-baʿdahu. Ṭūbā laki bimā fuzti bi-ayyām Allāh wa-āthārihi fī yawmin fīhi aʿraḍna imāʾ al-arḍ wa-malikātuhā. Innā wajadnā minki ʿarfa ḥubbī wa-l-tawajjuh ilā anwār wajhī. Nasʾalu Allāh taʿālā an yudkhilaki fī al-firdaws al-aʿlā wa-yuzayyinaki bi-l-iklīl al-muzayyana bi-smihi al-Abhā wa-yunzila ʿalayki fī kulli ḥīnin raḥmatan min ʿindihi wa-nūran min ladunhu. Innahu huwa al-Muqtadir al-Ghafūr al-Karīm. Al-bahāʾ min ladunnā ʿalayki wa-ʿalā al-imāʾ allāʾī yadhkurnaki bimā naṭaqa al-qalam al-aʿlā fī hādhihi al-layla al-dalmāʾ. Intahā.

“O Pen, remember the leaf who left her homeland, turning toward the Most Exalted Horizon, to appear before the Countenance, stand at the door, hear the call of the Wronged One, and behold the horizon of Revelation. I testify that she heard the call of her Lord, believed in Him, turned toward Him, and bore witness to that to which the Tongue of Grandeur bore witness. Blessed are you, My handmaiden and My leaf! You attained My remembrance before your ascension and after it. Blessed are you for having attained the days of God and His writings on a day when the women of the earth and its queens turned away. We perceived from you the fragrance of love for Me and of turning toward the lights of My face. We ask God, exalted be He, to admit you into the highest Paradise, adorn you with the crown adorned with His All-Glorious name, and send down upon you at every moment mercy from Himself and light from His presence. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Ever-Forgiving, the Generous. Glory from Us rest upon you and upon the handmaidens who remember you through what the Most Exalted Pen has uttered on this dark night.” Here it ends.

127

فی‌الحقیقه این ایّام ایّامیست انسان از یکجهت تفکّر مینماید موت میطلبد چه که بعد از ارتقا بآثار قلم اعلی فائز میشود و از جهت آخر بقا میطلبد بامید آنکه خدمتی از او ظاهر شود ولکن حقّ آنکه هرچه محبوب اراده فرموده آن محبوبست والسّلام خیر ختام مخصوص فرمودند جناب میرزا سلیمان و میرزا مهدی علیهما بهائی را تسلّی میدهیم و ذکر مینمائیم بآنچه که ابواب فرح بگشاید و حزن بسرور اکبر تبدیل شود در حین صعود از قلم اعلی در بارهٴ او نازل شد آنچه که باقی و دائمست انتهی

Fī al-ḥaqīqe īn ayyām ayyāmīst insān az yek jahat tafakkor mīnamāyad mawt mīṭalabad, che ke baʿd az irtiqā be-āthār-e qalam-e aʿlā fāʾez mīshavad, va az jahat-e ākhar baqā mīṭalabad be-omīd-e ānke khedmatī az ū ẓāher shavad. Va-lāken ḥaqq ānke harche Maḥbūb erāde farmūde ān maḥbūb ast. Va-l-salām khayr khitām. Makhṣūṣ farmūdand: Janāb-e Mīrzā Solaymān va Mīrzā Mahdī, ʿalayhimā bahāʾī, rā tasallī mīdahīm va dhekr mīnamāʾīm be-ānche ke abvāb-e faraḥ bogshāyad va ḥozn be-sorūr-e akbar tabdīl shavad. Dar ḥīn-e ṣoʿūd az qalam-e aʿlā dar bāre-ye ū nāzel shod ānche ke bāqī va dāʾem ast. Intahā.

Truly, these are days when, reflecting from one perspective, a person longs for death, since after ascending one attains the writings of the Most Exalted Pen; yet from another perspective, one longs to remain alive, in the hope of rendering some service. The truth, however, is that whatever the Beloved has willed is what is beloved. Peace is the best conclusion. He said specifically: “We console Jināb-i Mīrzā Sulaymān and Mīrzā Mahdī—My glory rest upon them both—and remember them with words that will open the gates of joy and transform sorrow into the greatest happiness. At the time of her ascension, there was revealed concerning her from the Most Exalted Pen that which is abiding and everlasting.” Here it ends.

128

از قبل هم در بارهٴ مخدّرهٴ مذکوره از قلم اعلی نازل شد آنچه که عرفش بدوام ملک و ملکوت باقی و پاینده است هنیئاً لها آنچه در بارهٴ جناب آقا میرزا محمود مراغه علیه بهآء اللّه ذکر فرمودند باجابت مقرون و اینعبد فانی بنیابت آنحضرت و ایشان در وقتی مخصوص بحضور فائز و بقبول مزیّن اسأله تعالی ان یجعل قطرة عملی بحراً من عنده انّه علی کلّشیء قدیر و همچنین ذکر جناب آقا میرزا مهدی شفافی علیه ٩ ٦٦ [بهآء الله] را فرمودند و استدعای عنایت مخصوص نمودند بعد از عرض لسان عظمت باین آیات ناطق قول الرّبّ تعالی و تقدّس

Az qabl ham dar bāre-ye mokhaddare-ye madhkūre az qalam-e aʿlā nāzel shod ānche ke ʿarfash be-davām-e molk va malakūt bāqī va pāyande ast. Hanīʾan lahā. Ānche dar bāre-ye Janāb-e Āqā Mīrzā Maḥmūd-e Marāghe, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, dhekr farmūdand be-ejābat maqrūn, va īn ʿabd-e fānī be-niyābat-e ān ḥażrat va īshān dar vaqtī makhṣūṣ be-ḥożūr fāʾez va be-qabūl mozayyan. Asʾaluhu taʿālā an yajʿala qaṭrata ʿamalī baḥran min ʿindihi, innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Va hamchenīn dhekr-e Janāb-e Āqā Mīrzā Mahdī-ye Shaffāfī, ʿalayhi 9 66 [bahāʾu Allāh], rā farmūdand va estedʿā-ye ʿenāyat-e makhṣūṣ namūdand. Baʿd az ʿarż lesān-e ʿaẓamat be-īn āyāt nāṭeq. Qawl al-Rabb taʿālā wa-taqaddas.

Previously, too, there was revealed from the Most Exalted Pen concerning the aforementioned lady that whose fragrance will endure as long as the earthly realm and the Kingdom endure. Blessed is she! What you mentioned concerning Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Maḥmūd of Marāghih—may the glory of God rest upon him—was granted, and this evanescent servant, acting on your behalf and his, attained His presence at a specially appointed time and was adorned with acceptance. I ask Him, exalted be He, to make the drop of my deed an ocean from Himself. He is powerful over all things. You also mentioned Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Mahdī Shaffāfī—upon him be 9 66 [the glory of God]—and requested special favor for him. After this was presented, the Tongue of Grandeur uttered these verses. The words of the Lord, exalted and sanctified be He:

129

بسمی المظلوم الغریب

Bi-smī al-Maẓlūm al-Gharīb.

“In My name, the Wronged One, the Stranger.”

130

حقّ جلّ جلاله در جمیع احیان بذکر دوستان مشغول لسان عظمت ناطق و قلمش متحرّک لعمراللّه بآثار قلمش معادله نمینماید آنچه ظاهر و مشهود است یا مهدی اشکر ربّک بهذه الکلمة العلیا انّک اذا وجدت نفحات بیان الرّحمن قل

Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu dar jamīʿ-e aḥyān be-dhekr-e dūstān mashghūl, lesān-e ʿaẓamat nāṭeq va qalamash motaḥarrek. La-ʿamru Allāh, be-āthār-e qalamash moʿādele namīnamāyad ānche ẓāher va mashhūd ast. Yā Mahdī, ushkur rabbaka bi-hādhihi al-kalima al-ʿulyā. Innaka idhā wajadta nafaḥāt bayān al-Raḥmān qul.

“God, exalted be His glory, is at all times occupied with remembering His friends. The Tongue of Grandeur speaks and His Pen moves. By the life of God, nothing visible or manifest can equal the writings of His Pen. O Mahdī, thank your Lord for this exalted utterance. When you sense the fragrances of the All-Merciful’s words, say:

131

الهی الهی اشهد انّک خلقتنی لعرفانک و التّوجّه الی انوار وجهک و الاقبال الی افق ظهورک و القیام لدی باب عظمتک و الحضور فی ساحة عزّک اسألک بآیاتک الکبری و ظهورات قدرتک فی ناسوت الانشآء و ببحر فضلک و سمآء علمک بأن تجعلنی مستقیماً علی امرک و منادیاً باسمک ای ربّ اکتب من قلم جودک لعبدک هذا ما یقرّبه الیک فی کلّ عالم من عوالمک ثمّ اکتب له ما کتبته لعبادک الّذین ما نقضوا عهدک و میثاقک و شربوا رحیق الوحی فی ایّامک من ایادی عطائک انّک انت المقتدر المهیمن العزیز الحکیم انتهی

Ilāhī ilāhī, ashhadu annaka khalaqtanī li-ʿirfānika wa-l-tawajjuh ilā anwār wajhika wa-l-iqbāl ilā ufuq ẓuhūrika wa-l-qiyām ladā bāb ʿaẓamatika wa-l-ḥuḍūr fī sāḥat ʿizzika. Asʾaluka bi-āyātika al-kubrā wa-ẓuhūrāt qudratika fī nāsūt al-inshāʾ wa-bi-baḥr faḍlika wa-samāʾ ʿilmika bi-an tajʿalanī mustaqīman ʿalā amrika wa-munādiyan bi-smika. Ay rabb, uktub min qalam jūdika li-ʿabdika hādhā mā yuqarribuhu ilayka fī kulli ʿālamin min ʿawālimika. Thumma uktub lahu mā katabtahu li-ʿibādika alladhīna mā naqaḍū ʿahdaka wa-mīthāqaka wa-sharibū raḥīq al-waḥy fī ayyāmika min ayādī ʿaṭāʾika. Innaka anta al-Muqtadir al-Muhaymin al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥakīm. Intahā.

‘My God, my God! I testify that You created me to know You, to turn toward the lights of Your face, to direct myself toward the horizon of Your Revelation, to stand at the gate of Your grandeur, and to appear in the court of Your glory. I ask You, by Your greatest signs, by the manifestations of Your power in the earthly realm of creation, by the ocean of Your grace and the heaven of Your knowledge, to make me steadfast in Your Cause and a herald of Your name. O Lord, ordain with the Pen of Your generosity for this servant of Yours what will draw him near to You in every world among Your worlds. Then ordain for him what You have ordained for Your servants who have not broken Your covenant and pledge, and who, in Your days, have drunk the choice wine of revelation from the hands of Your bounty. You are indeed the All-Powerful, the All-Protecting, the Almighty, the All-Wise.’” Here it ends.

132

و دستخطّ آنمحبوب فؤاد که باسم حبیب مکرّم جناب الف و حا علیه بهآء اللّه و عنایته ارسال شد بشرف اصغاء مقصود عالمیان فائز قوله تبارک و تعالی

Va dastkhaṭṭ-e ān maḥbūb-e foʾād ke be-esm-e ḥabīb-e mokarram Janāb-e Alif va Ḥā, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh va ʿenāyatuhu, ersāl shod be-sharaf-e eṣghā-ye Maqṣūd-e ʿālamiyān fāʾez. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā.

And your handwritten letter, beloved of the heart, which was sent in the name of the honored friend, Jināb-i Alif and Ḥā—may the glory of God and His loving-kindness rest upon him—attained the honor of being heard by the Desire of all worlds. His words, blessed and exalted be He:

133

الحمد للّه الّذی ایّد الألف و الحآء علی الاقبال الیه و التّمسّک بحبل فضله و التّشبّث بأذیال رحمته و القیام علی خدمة امره انّه هو المشفق المؤیّد الغفور الکریم یا ورقآء علیک بهائی و عنایتی قلم اعلی شهادت میدهد بر اقبال و توجّه و خدمت او در ایّامیکه از سطوت و طغیان اهل ارض فرائص وجود مضطرب او بحقّ مقبل و بعرفانش فائز و بذکرش ناطق و بکلمه‌اش مقرّ و معترف طوبی له و نعیماً له بشّره من قبلی و ذکّره بما نزّل من قلمی لیفرح و یکون من الشّاکرین انتهی

Al-ḥamdu li-llāh alladhī ayy ada al-Alif wa-l-Ḥāʾ ʿalā al-iqbāl ilayhi wa-l-tamassuk bi-ḥabl faḍlihi wa-l-tashabbuth bi-adhyāl raḥmatihi wa-l-qiyām ʿalā khidmat amrihi. Innahu huwa al-Mushfiq al-Muʾayyid al-Ghafūr al-Karīm. Yā Varqāʾ, ʿalayka bahāʾī wa-ʿināyatī. Qalam-e aʿlā shahādat mīdahad bar eqbāl va tavajjoh va khedmat-e ū. Dar ayyāmī ke az saṭvat va ṭoghyān-e ahl-e arż farāʾeṣ-e vojūd możṭareb, ū be-Ḥaqq moqbel va be-ʿerfānash fāʾez va be-dhekrash nāṭeq va be-kalame-ash moqerr va moʿtaref. Ṭūbā lahu wa-naʿīman lahu. Bashshirhu min qibalī wa-dhakkirhu bimā nuzzila min qalamī li-yafraḥa wa-yakūna min al-shākirīn. Intahā.

“Praise be to God, who has aided Alif and Ḥā to turn toward Him, hold fast to the cord of His grace, cling to the hem of His mercy, and arise to serve His Cause. He is indeed the Compassionate, the Helper, the Ever-Forgiving, the Generous. O Varqā, My glory and loving-kindness rest upon you. The Most Exalted Pen testifies to his turning toward God, his devotion, and his service. In days when the limbs of existence trembled at the might and tyranny of the people of the earth, he turned toward God, attained the knowledge of Him, spoke His remembrance, and acknowledged and professed His Word. Blessed is he, and bliss be his! Give him glad tidings on My behalf and remind him of what has been sent down from My Pen, that he may rejoice and be among the thankful.” Here it ends.

134

جناب محبوب روحانی امین علیه بهآء اللّه موافق ارادهٴ ایشان عمل نمودند مکرّر ذکر ایشان و ذکر ابناء ایشان و ذکر آقا میر علی اکبر و آقا میر علی اصغر علیهم بهآء اللّه را نموده و همچنین اولیای دیگر را از اهل میم و یا و سیسان جمیع را ذکر نموده و در اکثر نامه‌های ایشان ذکر آنحضرت هم بوده از حقّ میطلبم ایشان را تأیید فرماید در جمیع احوال بمحبّت اولیائش انّه هو المؤیّد المقتدر العلیم الحکیم

Janāb-e maḥbūb-e rūḥānī Amīn, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, movāfeq-e erāde-ye īshān ʿamal namūdand. Mokarrar dhekr-e īshān va dhekr-e abnā-ye īshān va dhekr-e Āqā Mīr ʿAlī Akbar va Āqā Mīr ʿAlī Aṣghar, ʿalayhim bahāʾu Allāh, rā namūde va hamchenīn awliyā-ye dīgar rā az ahl-e Mīm va Yā va Sīsān jamīʿ rā dhekr namūde, va dar akthar-e nāmehā-ye īshān dhekr-e ān ḥażrat ham būde. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabam īshān rā taʾyīd farmāyad dar jamīʿ-e aḥvāl be-maḥabbat-e awliyāyash. Innahu huwa al-Muʾayyid al-Muqtadir al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm.

The spiritually beloved Jināb-i Amīn—may the glory of God rest upon him—acted in accordance with his wishes. He has repeatedly mentioned him, his sons, Āqā Mīr ʿAlī Akbar, and Āqā Mīr ʿAlī Aṣghar—may the glory of God rest upon them—and has likewise mentioned all the other friends among the people of Mīm and Yā and Sīsān. In most of his letters, he has also mentioned you. I ask God to aid him under all circumstances in loving His friends. He is indeed the Helper, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

135

ورقهٴ اخری که از سدرهٴ محبّت محبوب عالمیان روئید بصورت و هیئة نامه رسید آفرین بر آن خامه و آمه که آب معنوی از او جاری و از آن آب که از عین محبّت جاری چون بر ارض اوراق رسید ازهار خلوص مخصوص و خضوع و خشوع و ذکر و ثنا روئید صدهزار آفرین بر آنخامه و بر آن آمه و آن نامه و بعد از استشمام ازهار و اطّلاع بر آثار قصد مقام اعزّ اعلی نموده بشرف اصغا فائز

Varaqe-ye okhrā ke az sedre-ye maḥabbat-e Maḥbūb-e ʿālamiyān rūʾīd be-ṣūrat va heyʾat-e nāme resīd. Āfarīn bar ān khāme va āme ke āb-e maʿnavī az ū jārī, va az ān āb ke az ʿayn-e maḥabbat jārī chon bar arż-e awrāq resīd azhār-e kholūṣ-e makhṣūṣ va khożūʿ va khoshūʿ va dhekr va thanā rūʾīd. Ṣad hezār āfarīn bar ān khāme va bar ān āme va ān nāme. Va baʿd az esteshmām-e azhār va eṭṭelāʿ bar āthār qaṣd-e maqām-e aʿazz-e aʿlā namūde be-sharaf-e eṣghā fāʾez.

Another leaf, which grew from the tree of love for the Beloved of all worlds, arrived in the form and shape of a letter. Praise be to that pen and inkwell from which spiritual water flows! When that water, flowing from the spring of love, reached the soil of the pages, flowers of singular sincerity, humility, reverence, remembrance, and praise sprang forth. A hundred thousand praises to that pen, that inkwell, and that letter! After inhaling the fragrance of the flowers and acquainting myself with the writings, I proceeded to the most glorious, most exalted station, and the letter attained the honor of being heard.

136

قول الرّبّ تعالی و تقدّس بسم الّذی به حمل اللّوح و تحرّک القلم

Qawl al-Rabb taʿālā wa-taqaddas: Bi-sm alladhī bihi ḥumila al-lawḥ wa-taḥarraka al-qalam.

The words of the Lord, exalted and sanctified be He: “In the name of Him through whom the Tablet was borne and the Pen set in motion.”

137

علیک بهآئی و عنایتی و رحمتی عبد حاضر با نامه حاضر ندای لسان فؤاد بشرف اصغا فائز شنیدیم و دیدیم طوبی لقلبک بما اقبل الی افقی المنیر و للسانه بما نطق بثنائی الجمیل و لوجهه بما استضآء من انوار الوجه و لذاته بما تذوت بحبّی العزیز المنیع یا ورقآء علیک عنایة اللّه و رحمته ایّام حضورت لازال در پیشگاه حضور مذکور قد قمت فی اوّل ایّامک علی خدمة امری و هدایة عبادی الی صراطی و تهذیب النّفوس بآیاتی و تطهیرهم بمآء عنایتی الّذی جری من سحاب سمآء مشیّتی طوبی لک و نعیماً لک و لمن احبّک لوجه اللّه ربّک و ربّ العالمین البهآء علیک و علی من معک انتهی

ʿAlayka bahāʾī wa-ʿināyatī wa-raḥmatī. ʿAbd ḥāżer bā nāme ḥāżer, nedā-ye lesān-e foʾād be-sharaf-e eṣghā fāʾez. Shenīdīm va dīdīm. Ṭūbā li-qalbika bimā aqbala ilā ufuqī al-munīr, wa-li-lisānihi bimā naṭaqa bi-thanāʾī al-jamīl, wa-li-wajhihi bimā istaḍāʾa min anwār al-wajh, wa-li-dhātihi bimā tadhawwata bi-ḥubbī al-ʿAzīz al-Manīʿ. Yā Varqāʾ, ʿalayka ʿināyatu Allāh wa-raḥmatuhu. Ayyām-e ḥożūrat lā zāl dar pīshgāh-e ḥożūr madhkūr. Qad qumta fī awwal ayyāmika ʿalā khidmat amrī wa-hidāyat ʿibādī ilā ṣirāṭī wa-tahdhīb al-nufūs bi-āyātī wa-taṭhīrihim bi-māʾ ʿināyatī alladhī jarā min saḥāb samāʾ mashīʾatī. Ṭūbā laka wa-naʿīman laka wa-li-man aḥabbaka li-wajh Allāh rabbika wa-rabb al-ʿālamīn. Al-bahāʾ ʿalayka wa-ʿalā man maʿaka. Intahā.

“My glory, My loving-kindness, and My mercy rest upon you. The servant is present with the letter; the call of the tongue of the heart has attained the honor of being heard. We have heard and seen. Blessed is your heart, for it has turned toward My luminous horizon; and its tongue, for it has voiced My beautiful praise; and its face, for it has been illumined by the lights of the Countenance; and its essence, for it has gained its being through love for Me, the Almighty, the Inaccessible. O Varqā, the loving-kindness of God and His mercy rest upon you. The days of your presence are ever remembered in this court. In your early days you arose to serve My Cause, guide My servants to My path, refine souls through My verses, and purify them with the water of My loving-kindness that flowed from the clouds of the heaven of My will. Blessed are you, and bliss be yours and his who loves you for the sake of God, your Lord and the Lord of all worlds. Glory rest upon you and upon those who are with you.” Here it ends.

138

له الحمد و الشّکر چه که در این لیلهٴ مبارکه عنایت مخصوصه شامل و آنحضرت بطراز مخصوص مزیّن انشآءاللّه مؤیّد و موفّق باشید بر تربیت عباد و تهذیب نفوس و تجذیب افئده و قلوب بعد از عرض مناجات امام وجه بحر اعظم بموجی ظاهر که اینعبد از ذکرش عاجز در آخر لسان عظمت باینکلمهٴ مبارکه ناطق ورقآء علیه بهائی و عنایتی بوجه قلب و لسان قلب و قلب قلب و ذات قلب توجّه نمود انّه اشتعل بنار حبّ ربّک و فاز بکوثر ذکره الجذّاب الفضّال المبعث المحیی المحرّک العلیم الحکیم و بعد باینکلمهٴ مبارکه ختم شد فرمودند هنیئاً له

Lahu al-ḥamd wa-l-shukr, che ke dar īn layle-ye mobārake ʿenāyat-e makhṣūṣe shāmel va ān ḥażrat be-ṭerāz-e makhṣūṣ mozayyan. In shāʾ Allāh moʾayyad va movaffaq bāshīd bar tarbiyat-e ʿebād va tahdhīb-e nofūs va tajdhīb-e afʾede va qolūb. Baʿd az ʿarż-e monājāt amām-e vajh baḥr-e aʿẓam be-mawjī ẓāher ke īn ʿabd az dhekrash ʿājez. Dar ākhar lesān-e ʿaẓamat be-īn kalame-ye mobārake nāṭeq: Varqāʾ, ʿalayhi bahāʾī wa-ʿināyatī, be-vajh-e qalb va lesān-e qalb va qalb-e qalb va dhāt-e qalb tavajjoh namūd. Innahu ishtaʿala bi-nār ḥubb rabbika wa-fāza bi-kawthar dhikrihi al-Jadhdhāb al-Faḍḍāl al-Mubʿith al-Muḥyī al-Muḥarrik al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Va baʿd be-īn kalame-ye mobārake khatm shod. Farmūdand: Hanīʾan lahu.

Praise and thanks be to Him, for on this blessed night special loving-kindness has encompassed you, and you have been adorned with a special distinction. God willing, may you be aided and enabled to educate His servants, refine souls, and attract hearts and inmost beings. After the prayer was presented before the Countenance, the Most Great Ocean surged with a wave that this servant is powerless to describe. At the end, the Tongue of Grandeur uttered these blessed words: “Varqā—My glory and loving-kindness rest upon him—turned toward Us with the face of his heart, the tongue of his heart, the heart of his heart, and the essence of his heart. He has been set ablaze with the fire of love for your Lord and has attained the heavenly stream of His remembrance, the All-Attracting, the Most Bountiful, the Quickener, the Giver of Life, the Mover, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.” Then it concluded with these blessed words. He said: “Blessed is he!”

139

در بارهٴ فقرهٴ معلوم آنچه واقع شد صحیح و مقبول بلی امثال این نفوس را نباید مأیوس نمود و همچنین نباید متابعت اهوی نمود بین بین باید نگاه داشت عجب در اینکه الی حین جناب حرف سین هم بر مقصود آگاه نه و حال آنکه دو کرّه در سجن اعظم فائز و هر کرّه مدّتی در جوار ساکن از حقّ جلّ جلاله سائل و آمل که او را بر مقصود آگاه فرماید وقتی از اوقات فرمودند از حقّ بطلبید او را مؤیّد فرماید بر آنچه سبب حفظ او و نجات اوست تقرّب در خدمت ملوک چون از حدّ تجاوز نماید بیم ضرّ است انتهی

Dar bāre-ye faqare-ye maʿlūm ānche vāqeʿ shod ṣaḥīḥ va maqbūl. Balī amthāl-e īn nofūs rā nabāyad maʾyūs namūd va hamchenīn nabāyad motābaʿat-e ahvā namūd. Bayn bayn bāyad negāh dāsht. ʿAjab dar īnke elā ḥīn Janāb-e Ḥarf-e Sīn ham bar maqṣūd āgāh na, va ḥāl ānke do karre dar sejn-e aʿẓam fāʾez va har karre moddatī dar javār sāken. Az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu sāʾel va āmel ke ū rā bar maqṣūd āgāh farmāyad. Vaqtī az awqāt farmūdand: Az Ḥaqq beṭalabīd ū rā moʾayyad farmāyad bar ānche sabab-e ḥefẓ-e ū va najāt-e ūst. Taq arrob dar khedmat-e molūk chon az ḥadd tajāvoz namāyad bīm-e żarr ast. Intahā.

Regarding the matter in question, what took place was correct and acceptable. Indeed, people such as these should not be discouraged, nor should their desires be followed. A middle course should be maintained. It is surprising that even Jināb-i Letter Sīn has not yet understood the purpose, although he attained the Most Great Prison twice and on each occasion resided nearby for a time. I ask God, exalted be His glory, and hope that He will acquaint him with the purpose. On one occasion He said: “Ask God to aid him in that which will bring about his protection and salvation. When seeking closeness in the service of kings exceeds its bounds, there is a danger of harm.” Here it ends.

140

این خادم فانی از حقّ میطلبد حضرت معین را مؤیّد فرماید بر اعلاء کلمه و انتشار امر اگر باینمقام توجّه فرمایند البتّه تأیید الهی و رحمت رحمانی مدد نماید و آنچه سزاوار است عطا کند ذکر مخدوم مکرّم جناب میرزا ف ض علیه ٩ ٦٦ [بهآ الله] نموده بودند چندی قبل یک لوح امنع اقدس از سماء فضل مخصوص ایشان نازل و ارسال شد از هر حرفی از آن لوح مبارک نفحات عنایات لایزالی متضوّع للّه الحمد مؤیّدند بر استقامت و خدمت و ذکر و ثنا خدمت ایشان سلام و ثنا و تکبیر و بهاء میرسانم انشآءاللّه آثار فضل ایشان از اشطار و اقطار بامر مقتدر مختار ظاهر و هویدا گردد

Īn khādem-e fānī az Ḥaqq mīṭalabad Ḥażrat-e Moʿīn rā moʾayyad farmāyad bar eʿlā-ye kalame va enteshār-e amr. Agar be-īn maqām tavajjoh farmāyand albatte taʾyīd-e elāhī va raḥmat-e raḥmānī madad namāyad va ānche sazāvār ast ʿaṭā konad. Dhekr-e makhdūm-e mokarram Janāb-e Mīrzā F Ḍ, ʿalayhi 9 66 [bahā Allāh], namūde būdand. Chandī qabl yek lawḥ-e amnaʿ-e aqdas az samā-ye fażl makhṣūṣ-e īshān nāzel va ersāl shod. Az har ḥarfī az ān lawḥ-e mobārak nafaḥāt-e ʿenāyāt-e lā yazālī motaḍavveʿ. Li-llāh al-ḥamd moʾayyadand bar esteqāmat va khedmat va dhekr va thanā. Khedmat-e īshān salām va thanā va takbīr va bahā mīresānam. In shāʾ Allāh āthār-e fażl-e īshān az ashṭār va aqṭār be-amr-e Moqtader-e Mokhtār ẓāher va hovaydā gardad.

This evanescent servant asks God to aid Ḥaḍrat-i Muʿīn in exalting the Word and spreading the Cause. If he turns his attention to this station, divine assistance and the mercy of the All-Merciful will assuredly aid him and bestow what is fitting. You had mentioned the honored gentleman, Jināb-i Mīrzā F. Ḍ.—upon him be 9 66 [the glory of God]. Some time ago, a most exalted, most holy Tablet was revealed from the heaven of grace especially for him and was sent. From every letter of that blessed Tablet waft the fragrances of everlasting loving-kindness. Praise be to God, he is aided in steadfastness, service, remembrance, and praise. I convey to him greetings, praise, magnification, and glory. God willing, the effects of his excellence will become manifest and evident throughout the regions and lands at the command of the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.

141

جمیع حاضرین و طائفین تکبیر میرسانند و سلام میگویند و بثنا ذاکرند و در باب فقرهٴ معهود باید بروایت شیعه بحدیث قبل عمل نمود که فرموده‌اند لا جبر و لا تفویض بل امر بین الأمرین سبحان‌اللّه الی حین نزد حضرات عنایت و شفقّت و مرحمت حقّ جلّ جلاله معلوم نه مع آنکه جمیع الواح شاهد و گواهست یسأل الخادم ربّه بان یؤیّدهم علی عرفان ما اراد انّه هو السّامع المجیب

Jamīʿ-e ḥāżerīn va ṭāʾefīn takbīr mīrasānand va salām mīgūyand va be-thanā dhākerand va dar bāb-e faqare-ye maʿhūd bāyad be-revāyat-e Shīʿe be-ḥadīth-e qabl ʿamal namūd ke farmūde-and lā jabr wa-lā tafwīḍ bal amr bayna al-amrayn. Subḥān Allāh, elā ḥīn nazd-e ḥażarāt ʿenāyat va shafaqat va marḥamat-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu maʿlūm na maʿ-e ānke jamīʿ-e alvāḥ shāhed va govāh ast. Yasʾalu al-khādim rabbahu bi-an yuʾayyidahum ʿalā ʿirfān mā arād. Innahu huwa al-Sāmiʿ al-Mujīb.

All those present and those who circle around convey greetings of glorification, send their salutations, and offer praise. Regarding the matter in question, one should act according to the previously cited tradition transmitted by the Shiʿa, which states: “Neither compulsion nor delegation, but a matter between the two.” Glory be to God! To this day, these gentlemen have not understood the loving-kindness, compassion, and mercy of God, exalted be His glory, although all the Tablets bear witness and testify to it. This servant asks his Lord to help them recognize what He has intended. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the Responsive.

142

ذکر قرّهٴ عین الموسوم به ولیّ‌اللّه علیه بهآء اللّه در ساحت اقدس معروض این آیات باهرات مخصوص آن قرّهٴ عین و سایر قرر عیون علیهم حفظ اللّه و عنایته نازل قول الرّبّ تعالی و تقدّس

Dhekr-e qorrat-e ʿayn al-mawsūm be-Valīyuʾllāh ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh dar sāḥat-e aqdas maʿrūż. Īn āyāt-e bāherāt makhṣūṣ-e ān qorrat-e ʿayn va sāyer-e qorar-e ʿoyūn ʿalayhim ḥifẓ Allāh wa-ʿināyatuhu nāzel. Qawl al-Rabb taʿālā wa-taqaddas:

Mention of that solace of the eyes named Valīyuʾllāh—upon him be the glory of God—was presented at the Most Holy Court. These resplendent verses were revealed especially for that solace of the eyes and the other cherished children—may God’s protection and loving-kindness rest upon them. These are the words of the Lord, exalted and sanctified is He:

143

هو النّاطق فیملکوت البیان

Huwa al-Nāṭiq fī malakūt al-bayān.

He is the One who speaks in the kingdom of utterance.

144

طوبی لک بما اقبلت فی اوّل ایّامک الی ربّک ربّ العرش العظیم قل الهی الهی ترانی مقبلاً الی سمآء ظهورک و ناطقاً بثنائک و آیاتک و معترفاً بما اشرق من افق ملکوت عرفانک اسألک بأن تجعلنی مؤیّداً علی نصرة امرک و اعلآء کلمتک بحیث ترتفع رایات امرک فی مدنک و دیارک انّک انت مولی العالم و مربّی الأمم لا اله الّا انت القویّ القدیر

Ṭūbā laka bi-mā aqbalta fī awwal ayyāmika ilā rabbika rabb al-ʿarsh al-ʿaẓīm. Qul ilāhī ilāhī tarānī muqbilan ilā samāʾ ẓuhūrika wa-nāṭiqan bi-thanāʾika wa-āyātika wa-muʿtarifan bi-mā ashraqa min ufuq malakūt ʿirfānika. Asʾaluka bi-an tajʿalanī muʾayyadan ʿalā nuṣrat amrika wa-iʿlāʾ kalimatika bi-ḥaythu tartafiʿ rāyāt amrika fī mudunika wa-diyārika. Innaka anta mawlā al-ʿālam wa-murabbī al-umam. Lā ilāha illā anta al-Qawī al-Qadīr.

Blessed are you for having turned, in your earliest days, toward your Lord, the Lord of the mighty throne. Say: “My God, my God! You see me turning toward the heaven of Your revelation, voicing Your praise and Your verses, and acknowledging what has shone from the horizon of the kingdom of Your recognition. I ask You to aid me in championing Your Cause and exalting Your Word, so that the banners of Your Cause may be raised in Your cities and Your lands. You are indeed the Lord of the world and the Educator of the nations. There is no God but You, the Strong, the All-Powerful.”

145

و هذا ما نزل لعزیزاللّه علیه بهآء اللّه

Wa-hādhā mā nazala li-ʿAzīzuʾllāh ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh.

And this is what was revealed for ʿAzīzuʾllāh—upon him be the glory of God:

146

بسمی المشرق من افق سمآء البرهان

Bi-ismī al-mushriq min ufuq samāʾ al-burhān.

In My name, shining from the horizon of the heaven of proof.

147

قد سمع المظلوم ندائک و اجابک بما کان للأراضی الطّیّبة المبارکه رذاذ الرّحمة و لریاض المعرفة نسمة العنایة و لسمآء البیان شمس الایقان و للعطشان کوثر الحیوان و لأهل البهآء رائحة الرّحمن اشکر قلمی الأعلی انّه ذکرک بما یکون باقیاً بدوام ملکوت اللّه ربّ العالمین

Qad samiʿa al-Maẓlūm nidāʾaka wa-ajābaka bi-mā kāna li-l-arāḍī al-ṭayyiba al-mubāraka radhādh al-raḥma wa-li-riyāḍ al-maʿrifa nasmat al-ʿināya wa-li-samāʾ al-bayān shams al-īqān wa-li-l-ʿaṭshān kawthar al-ḥayawān wa-li-ahl al-Bahāʾ rāʾiḥat al-Raḥmān. Ushkur qalamī al-aʿlā innahu dhakaraka bi-mā yakūnu bāqiyan bi-dawām malakūt Allāh rabb al-ʿālamīn.

The Wronged One has heard your call and answered you with that which is a gentle rain of mercy for the good and blessed lands, a breeze of loving-kindness for the gardens of knowledge, a sun of certitude for the heaven of utterance, a river of life for the thirsty, and the fragrance of the All-Merciful for the people of Bahāʾ. Give thanks to My Most Exalted Pen: it has indeed made mention of you in words that will endure as long as the kingdom of God, the Lord of the worlds.

148

هذا ما نزّل لروح اللّه علیه بهآء اللّه

Hādhā mā nuzzila li-Rūḥuʾllāh ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh.

This is what was revealed for Rūḥuʾllāh—upon him be the glory of God:

149

بنام آنکه پنهانست در حینیکه ظاهر و هویداست

Be-nām-e ānke penhān ast dar ḥīnī ke ẓāher va hovaydāst.

In the name of Him who is hidden even while He is manifest and evident.

150

آنچه لسان فؤاد بآن نطق نمود بشرف اصغا فائز قل الهی الهی لک الحمد بما خلقتنی بکلمتک العلیا و اظهرتنی فی ایّامک یا مولی الوری و ربّ العرش و الثّری اسألک بالسّفینة الّتی استوی علیها البحر الأعظم و بأمرک الّذی به سخّرت العالم بأن تجعلنی ساکناً فی ظلّ قباب رحمتک و سمآء فضلک ثمّ قدّر لی ما یقرّبنی الیک فی کلّ الأحوال و یؤیّدنی علی نصرة امرک انّک انت الغنیّ المتعال لا اله الّا انت العزیز الفضّال انتهی للّه الحمد

Ānche lesān-e foʾād be-ān noṭq namūd be-sharaf-e eṣghā fāʾez. Qul ilāhī ilāhī laka al-ḥamd bi-mā khalaqtanī bi-kalimatika al-ʿulyā wa-aẓhartanī fī ayyāmika yā mawlā al-warā wa-rabb al-ʿarsh wa-l-tharā. Asʾaluka bi-l-safīna allatī istawā ʿalayhā al-baḥr al-aʿẓam wa-bi-amrika alladhī bihi sakhkharta al-ʿālam bi-an tajʿalanī sākinan fī ẓill qibāb raḥmatika wa-samāʾ faḍlika. Thumma qaddir lī mā yuqarribunī ilayka fī kull al-aḥwāl wa-yuʾayyidunī ʿalā nuṣrat amrika. Innaka anta al-Ghanī al-Mutaʿāl. Lā ilāha illā anta al-ʿAzīz al-Faḍḍāl. Intahā. Li-llāh al-ḥamd.

What the tongue of your heart uttered attained the honor of being heard. Say: “My God, my God! Praise be to You for having created me through Your most exalted Word and brought me into being in Your days, O Lord of all creation and Lord of the throne and the earth. I ask You, by the Ark upon which the Most Great Ocean has established itself, and by Your Cause through which You have subdued the world, to let me dwell beneath the shelter of the domes of Your mercy and the heaven of Your grace. Then ordain for me what will draw me nearer to You in every circumstance and aid me in championing Your Cause. You are indeed the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. There is no God but You, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful.” Here it ends. Praise be to God.

151

قرر عیون بعنایات مقصود عالمیان فائز گشتند از برای هر یک نعمت باقیه و مائدهٴ معنویّه از سمآء فضل نازل هنیئاً لهم در حین عرض تبسّم فرمودند و بحر عنایت به موجی بدیع و اوجی عظیم ظاهر و هویدا له الحمد و الثّناء و له الشّکر و البهآء و مولود جدید علیه بهآء اللّه العزیز الحمید که بطراز اسم بدیع‌اللّه مزیّن در آنحین بشرف امضاء مشرّف نعیماً له این خادم از حقّ سائل و آمل که هر یک را تأیید فرماید تأییدیکه از آیات منزله واضح و مشهود یا ورقا علیک بهائی و عنایتی للّه الحمد آنجناب خود باین شرافت کبری فائزید و باین موهبت عظمی مزیّن یشهد بذلک لسان عظمتی و لسان فضلی و لسان عنایتی و لسان بیانی البدیع انتهی

Qorar-e ʿoyūn be-ʿenāyāt-e Maqṣūd-e ʿālamiyān fāʾez gashtand. Az barā-ye har yek neʿmat-e bāqiye va māʾede-ye maʿnaviyye az samāʾ-e fażl nāzel. Hanīʾan lahum. Dar ḥīn-e ʿarż tabassom farmūdand va baḥr-e ʿenāyat be-mowjī badīʿ va owjī ʿaẓīm ẓāher va hovaydā. Lahu al-ḥamd wa-l-thanāʾ wa-lahu al-shukr wa-l-bahāʾ. Va mowlūd-e jadīd ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd ke be-ṭerāz-e esm-e Badīʿuʾllāh mozayyan dar ān ḥīn be-sharaf-e emżā mosharraf. Naʿīman lahu. Īn khādem az Ḥaqq sāʾel va āmel ke har yek rā taʾyīd farmāyad taʾyīdī ke az āyāt-e monzale vāżeḥ va mashhūd. Yā Warqāʾ ʿalayka bahāʾī wa-ʿināyatī. Li-llāh al-ḥamd ān janāb khod be-īn sharāfat-e kobrā fāʾezīd va be-īn mowhebat-e ʿoẓmā mozayyan. Yashhadu bi-dhālika lisān ʿaẓamatī wa-lisān faḍlī wa-lisān ʿināyatī wa-lisān bayānī al-badīʿ. Intahā.

The cherished children have received the favors of the Desire of all the worlds. For each of them, an enduring blessing and a spiritual feast have descended from the heaven of grace. May it bring them joy! As their names were presented, He smiled, and the ocean of loving-kindness rose in a wondrous wave to a mighty height. His are all praise and glorification, and His are all thanksgiving and glory. At that time, the newborn—upon him be the glory of God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—who is adorned with the name Badīʿuʾllāh, was honored with approval. May bliss be his! This servant asks God and hopes that He will strengthen each one with the aid that is clear and evident in the revealed verses. “O Warqāʾ, upon you be My glory and My loving-kindness.” Praise be to God, you yourself have attained this supreme distinction and are adorned with this most great gift. “To this testify the tongue of My grandeur, the tongue of My grace, the tongue of My loving-kindness, and the tongue of My wondrous utterance.” Here it ends.

152

هذا فضل آخر و نعمة اخری و رحمة اخری و موهبة اخری من لدی اللّه ربّنا و ربّ من فی السّموات و الأرضین

Hādhā faḍl ākhar wa-niʿma ukhrā wa-raḥma ukhrā wa-mawhiba ukhrā min ladā Allāh rabbinā wa-rabb man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍīn.

This is yet another grace, another blessing, another mercy, and another gift from God, our Lord and the Lord of all who are in the heavens and the earth.

153

اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا میرزا آقا ش علیه بهآء اللّه و ارادهٴ توجّه ایشان بانوار وجه محبوب و اشتعالشان بنار فراق مرقوم داشتند اینمراتب بسمع من خلقت الآذان لاصغآء ندائه فائز هذا ما نطق به لسان العظمة فی الجواب قول الرّبّ تعالی و تقدّس

Īnke dar bāre-ye janāb-e Āqā Mīrzā Āqā Sh. ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh va erāde-ye tavajjoh-e īshān be-anvār-e vajh-e Maḥbūb va eshteʿāl-e shān be-nār-e ferāq marqūm dāshtand īn marāteb be-samʿ-e man khuliqat al-ādhān li-iṣghāʾ nidāʾihi fāʾez. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi lisān al-ʿaẓama fī al-jawāb. Qawl al-Rabb taʿālā wa-taqaddas:

What you wrote concerning Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Āqā Sh.—upon him be the glory of God—his wish to turn toward the lights of the Beloved’s countenance, and his burning in the fire of separation, attained the hearing of Him for whose call ears were created to listen. This is what the Tongue of Grandeur uttered in reply. These are the words of the Lord, exalted and sanctified is He:

154

هو الشّاهد الخبیر

Huwa al-Shāhid al-Khabīr.

He is the Witness, the All-Aware.

155

قد سمعنا ندآئک و رأینا توجّهک و اقبالک و اشتعالک فی هجر مولیک انّا ذکرناک من قبل بما فاحت به نفحة الرّحمن فی الامکان نسأل اللّه ان یؤیّدک و یوفّقک علی ذکره و ثنائه و خدمة امره انّه هو المقتدر المهیمن القیّوم انّک اذا شربت رحیق الوحی من کأس بیانی و وجدت عرف الرّحمن من کلماتی

Qad samiʿnā nidāʾaka wa-raʾaynā tawajjuhaka wa-iqbālaka wa-ishtiʿālaka fī hajr mawlāka. Innā dhakarnāka min qabl bi-mā fāḥat bihi nafḥat al-Raḥmān fī al-imkān. Nasʾalu Allāh an yuʾayyidaka wa-yuwaffiqaka ʿalā dhikrihi wa-thanāʾihi wa-khidmat amrihi. Innahu huwa al-Muqtadir al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Innaka idhā sharibta raḥīq al-waḥy min kaʾs bayānī wa-wajadta ʿarf al-Raḥmān min kalimātī

We have heard your call and seen your turning toward Us, your devotion, and your burning in separation from your Lord. We have previously made mention of you in words through which the breeze of the All-Merciful has wafted throughout existence. We ask God to aid you and enable you to remember and praise Him and to serve His Cause. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. When you have drunk the choice wine of revelation from the cup of My utterance and perceived the fragrance of the All-Merciful from My words,

156

قل الهی الهی هجرک اهلکنی و فراقک احرقنی و ظهورک حیّرنی و آیاتک اشعلتنی و بیّناتک جذبتنی اسألک بالکلمة الّتی بها سرع المقرّبون الی مقرّ الفدآء بأن تکتب لی من قلمک الأعلی اجر لقائک و الحضور امام وجهک و القیام لدی باب عظمتک ای ربّ ترانی منجذباً من نفحات وحیک و طائراً فی هوآء حبّک اسألک بأمطار فجر ظهورک و انوار وجهک بأن تجعلنی فیکلّ الأحوال متمسّکاً بحبل فضلک و عاملاً بما امرتنی به فی کتابک انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء لا اله الّا انت القویّ القدیر

Qul ilāhī ilāhī hajruka ahlakanī wa-firāquka aḥraqanī wa-ẓuhūruka ḥay yaranī wa-āyātuka ashʿalatanī wa-bayyinātuka jadhabatnī. Asʾaluka bi-l-kalima allatī bihā saraʿa al-muqarrabūn ilā maqarr al-fidāʾ bi-an taktuba lī min qalamika al-aʿlā ajr liqāʾika wa-l-ḥuḍūr amāma wajhika wa-l-qiyām ladā bāb ʿaẓamatika. Ay rabb tarānī munjadhiban min nafaḥāt waḥyika wa-ṭāʾiran fī hawāʾ ḥubbika. Asʾaluka bi-amṭār fajr ẓuhūrika wa-anwār wajhika bi-an tajʿalanī fī kull al-aḥwāl mutamassikan bi-ḥabl faḍlika wa-ʿāmilan bi-mā amartanī bihi fī kitābika. Innaka anta al-Muqtadir ʿalā mā tashāʾ. Lā ilāha illā anta al-Qawī al-Qadīr.

say: “My God, my God! Separation from You has brought me to ruin, and distance from You has consumed me. Your revelation has bewildered me, Your verses have set me aflame, and Your clear proofs have drawn me to You. I ask You, by the Word through which those who are near to You hastened to the place of sacrifice, to inscribe for me, with Your Most Exalted Pen, the reward of meeting You, of being present before Your face, and of standing at the door of Your grandeur. O Lord, You see me enraptured by the breezes of Your revelation and soaring in the atmosphere of Your love. I ask You, by the rains of the dawn of Your revelation and the lights of Your countenance, to enable me in every circumstance to hold fast to the cord of Your grace and to act according to what You have commanded me in Your Book. You indeed have power over whatever You will. There is no God but You, the Strong, the All-Powerful.”

157

حقّ اولیای خود را دوست داشته و دارد و از برای لقا و ظهورات عنایت و مرحمت آمده ولکن ظلم ظالمین و غفلت غافلین حایل شده چندیست ارض سجن مضطرب مشاهده میشود چه که نفسی از اهل بغضا مدّتی بر سریر حکومت جالس اگرچه بسقر راجع یعنی عزل شد ولکن الی حین ارض ساکن نشده لذا در اظهار کلمهٴ اذن توقّف نمودیم انّه هو الفضّال الکریم و هو الغفور الرّحیم از او میطلبیم آنچه را که خیر دنیا و آخرت در آنست انّه علی کلّشیء قدیر و بالاجابة جدیر انتهی

Ḥaqq owliyā-ye khod rā dūst dāshte va dārad va az barā-ye leqā va ẓohūrāt-e ʿenāyat va marḥamat āmade va-līkan ẓolm-e ẓālemīn va ghaflat-e ghāfelīn ḥāʾel shode. Chandīst arż-e sejn możṭareb moshāhede mīshavad che ke nafsī az ahl-e baghżā moddatī bar sarīr-e ḥokūmat jāles. Agarche be-Saqar rājeʿ yaʿnī ʿazl shod va-līkan elā ḥīn arż sāken nashode. Ledhā dar eẓhār-e kalame-ye edhn tavaqqof namūdīm. Innahu huwa al-Faḍḍāl al-Karīm wa-huwa al-Ghafūr al-Raḥīm. Az ū mīṭalabīm ānche rā ke khayr-e donyā va ākherat dar ān ast. Innahu ʿalā kull shayʾ qadīr wa-bi-l-ijāba jadīr. Intahā.

God has loved and continues to love His loved ones, and has come so that they may meet Him and witness the manifestations of His loving-kindness and mercy. But the oppression of the oppressors and the heedlessness of the heedless have intervened. For some time, the land of the prison has been seen to be in turmoil, for a person from among the people of hatred occupied the seat of government for a while. Although he returned to hell—that is, he was dismissed—the land has not yet become calm. We have therefore refrained from uttering the word of permission. He is indeed the All-Bountiful, the Generous, and He is the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. We ask Him for that in which lies the good of this world and the next. He indeed has power over all things and is worthy to answer prayers. Here it ends.

158

للّه الحمد فائز شدند بآنچه که شبه و مثل نداشته و ندارد تفصیل این ارض البتّه الی حین بسمع آنجناب رسیده اینعبد هم خدمت ایشان تکبیر میرساند و از حقّ جلّ جلاله خیر دنیا و آخرت میطلبد اینکه مجدّد در بارهٴ جناب حاجی محمّد علی علیه ٩ ٦٦ [بهآ الله] مرقوم داشتند یوم ورود دستخطّ آنمحبوب آنچه اراده نمودند در ساحت اقدس عرض شد و بشرف امضا فائز هنیئاً له و جناب محبوب فؤاد امین علیه بهآء اللّه هم در ساحت اقدس مطالب ایشانرا عرض نمودند و امضا را باذن خود شنیدند و همچنین لوحی هم مخصوص ایشان از قبل نازل و ارسال شد یسأل الخادم ربّه بأن یؤیّد اولیآئه علی ما یحبّ و یرضی و یقدّر لهم خیر ما نزل فی کتابه المبین

Li-llāh al-ḥamd fāʾez shodand be-ānche ke shebh va methl nadāshte va nadārad. Tafṣīl-e īn arż albatte elā ḥīn be-samʿ-e ān janāb resīde. Īn ʿabd ham khedmat-e īshān takbīr mīrasānad va az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu khayr-e donyā va ākherat mīṭalabad. Īnke mojaddad dar bāre-ye janāb-e Ḥājī Moḥammad ʿAlī ʿalayhi 9 66 [Bahāʾ Allāh] marqūm dāshtand yowm-e vorūd-e dastkhaṭṭ-e ān maḥbūb ānche erāde namūdand dar sāḥat-e aqdas ʿarż shod va be-sharaf-e emżā fāʾez. Hanīʾan lahu. Va janāb-e maḥbūb-e foʾād Amīn ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh ham dar sāḥat-e aqdas maṭāleb-e īshān rā ʿarż namūdand va emżā rā be-ozon-e khod shenīdand va hamchenīn lowḥī ham makhṣūṣ-e īshān az qabl nāzel va ersāl shod. Yasʾalu al-khādim rabbahu bi-an yuʾayyida awliyāʾahu ʿalā mā yuḥibbu wa-yarḍā wa-yuqaddira lahum khayr mā nazala fī kitābihi al-mubīn.

Praise be to God, he has attained what has never had, and does not have, any likeness or equal. The details of events in this land have surely reached your hearing by now. This servant also conveys greetings of glorification to him and asks God, exalted be His glory, to grant him the good of this world and the next. Regarding what you wrote again concerning Jināb-i Ḥājī Muḥammad ʿAlī—upon him be 9 66 [the glory of God]—on the day the letter from you, that beloved friend, arrived, what he desired was presented at the Most Holy Court and received the honor of approval. May it bring him joy! Jināb-i Amīn, the beloved of the heart—upon him be the glory of God—also presented his requests at the Most Holy Court and heard the approval with his own ears. Likewise, a Tablet had previously been revealed especially for him and sent. This servant asks his Lord to aid His loved ones in what He loves and approves, and to ordain for them the best of what has been revealed in His lucid Book.

159

و اینکه در ذکر الوهیّت مرقوم فرمودند که شخصی را از شنیدن آن پریشانی دست داد بعد از عرض اینفقر اینکلمات عالیات از مشرق اراده ظاهر و

Va īnke dar dhekr-e olūhiyyat marqūm farmūdand ke shakhṣī rā az shenīdan-e ān parīshānī dast dād baʿd az ʿarż-e īn faqre īn kalemāt-e ʿāliyāt az mashreq-e erāde ẓāher va

And regarding what you wrote concerning divinity, that someone had become distressed on hearing it mentioned, after this matter was presented, these exalted words appeared from the dayspring of the Will and

160

مشرق قوله تبارک و تعالی یا ورقآء علیک بهائی و عنایتی ناس ضعیفند الی حین قلم اعلی بما ینبغی ذکر ننموده مکلّم طور مع آنکه آیاتش عالم را احاطه نموده خود را صامت مشاهده مینماید و الی حین جهل اهل فرقان بتمامه ذکر نشده لعمراللّه از کأس توحید محرومند و از قدح تفرید ممنوع الی حین مقام توحید حقیقی مستور و این ستر فضلی است بزرگ از برای بعضی از نفوس که اقبال نموده‌اند اگرچه نفحهٴ اینمقام از قلم اعلی متضوّع مقصود آنکه آذان مستعدّه لاصغآء ندآء اللّه و ابصار حدیده لمشاهدة ما ظهر من خزائن القلم قلیل مشاهده میشود آنجناب باید مدارا نمایند و باذکاری ناطق شوند که سبب توجّه و اقبال و انجذابست چه که مراتب و مقامات اولیای فرقان و مراتب آنچه سزاوار ظهور است اگر بعضی مستور ماند اقرب بتقوی است حال محبّت و اقبال کافیست و بعد از اقبال و توجّه اکثری بحبل بیان ارتقا مینمایند و بقدر استعداد بر مراتب واقف میشوند قدّرنا لک خیراً کثیراً فی الکتاب انتهی

Moshreq. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: Yā Warqāʾ ʿalayka bahāʾī wa-ʿināyatī. Nās żaʿīfand. Elā ḥīn Qalam-e Aʿlā bi-mā yanbaghī dhekr nanamūde. Mokallem-e Ṭūr maʿ-e ānke āyātash ʿālam rā eḥāṭe namūde khod rā ṣāmet moshāhede mīnamāyad va elā ḥīn jahl-e ahl-e Forqān be-tamāme dhekr nashode. La-ʿamru Allāh az kaʾs-e towḥīd maḥrūmand va az qadaḥ-e tafrīd mamnūʿ. Elā ḥīn maqām-e towḥīd-e ḥaqīqī mastūr va īn satr fażlī ast bozorg az barā-ye baʿżī az nofūs ke eqbāl namūde-and agarche nafḥe-ye īn maqām az Qalam-e Aʿlā motaḍavveʿ. Maqṣūd ānke ādhān-e mostaʿedde li-iṣghāʾ nidāʾ Allāh va abṣār-e ḥadīde li-mushāhadat mā ẓahara min khazāʾin al-qalam qalīl moshāhede mīshavad. Ān janāb bāyad modārā namāyand va be-adhkārī nāṭeq shavand ke sabab-e tavajjoh va eqbāl va enjedhāb ast che ke marāteb va maqāmāt-e owliyā-ye Forqān va marāteb-e ānche sazāvār-e ẓohūr ast agar baʿżī mastūr mānad aqrab be-taqvā ast. Ḥāl maḥabbat va eqbāl kāfīst va baʿd az eqbāl va tavajjoh aktharī be-ḥabl-e bayān erteqā mīnamāyand va be-qadr-e esteʿdād bar marāteb vāqef mīshavand. Qaddarnā laka khayran kathīran fī al-kitāb. Intahā.

shone forth. His words, blessed and exalted is He: “O Warqāʾ, upon you be My glory and My loving-kindness. People are weak. To this day, the Most Exalted Pen has not spoken as is befitting. Although His verses have encompassed the world, He who spoke on Sinai regards Himself as silent, and the ignorance of the people of the Qurʾān has not yet been fully described. By the life of God, they are deprived of the cup of divine unity and barred from the chalice of singleness. To this day, the station of true divine unity remains concealed. This concealment is a great favor to some of the souls who have turned toward Him, although the fragrance of this station wafts from the Most Exalted Pen. The point is that few ears are found ready to hear the call of God, and few eyes keen enough to behold what has appeared from the treasuries of the Pen. You should show forbearance and speak of things that will cause people to turn toward Him, embrace His Cause, and be attracted to Him. For if some aspects of the ranks and stations of the holy ones of the Qurʾān, and of the degrees of what is fitting for this Revelation, remain concealed, this is nearer to piety. For now, love and acceptance suffice. After accepting and turning toward Him, most ascend by the cord of utterance and become acquainted with these degrees according to their capacity. We have ordained abundant good for you in the Book.” Here it ends.

161

یا محبوب فؤادی اکثری رضیعند شیر میطلبند قابل فوق آن نبوده و نیستند نسأل اللّه تعالی ان یؤیّد عباده علی ذکره و ثنآئه و الاقبال الیه و التّوکّل علیه انّه هو السّامع المجیب و هو الفرد الواحد العزیز الحمید

Yā maḥbūb-e foʾādī aktharī rażīʿand shīr mīṭalaband qābel-e fowq-e ān nabūde va nīstand. Nasʾalu Allāh taʿālā an yuʾayyida ʿibādahu ʿalā dhikrihi wa-thanāʾihi wa-l-iqbāl ilayhi wa-l-tawakkul ʿalayhi. Innahu huwa al-Sāmiʿ al-Mujīb wa-huwa al-Fard al-Wāḥid al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd.

O beloved of my heart, most are nursing infants: they seek milk and have never been, nor are they now, capable of taking anything beyond it. We ask God, exalted is He, to aid His servants in remembering and praising Him, turning toward Him, and placing their trust in Him. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the Responsive, and He is the Unique, the One, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

162

عرایضیکه بساحت اقدس ارسال شد جواب نازل از حقّ میطلبم از اشراقات انوار آفتاب حقیقی که از افق لوح مشرقست اولیای آن دیار طرّاً منوّر شوند و از نار بدیعهٴ منیعه مشتعل گردند و به اتّحاد و اتّفاق قیام نمایند و با صدور منیرهٴ مطهّرهٴ از ضغینه و بغضا باصلاح عالم پردازند تا نور اتّفاق عالم را اخذ نماید و عداوتهای مکنونهٴ در صدور ساکن شود و زایل گردد

ʿArāyeżī ke be sāḥat-e aqdas ersāl shod javāb nāzel. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabam az eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e ḥaqīqī ke az ofoq-e lawḥ moshreq ast awliyā-ye ān diyār ṭorran monavvar shavand va az nār-e badīʿe-ye manīʿe moshtaʿel gardand va be etteḥād va ettefāq qiyām namāyand va bā ṣodūr-e monīre-ye moṭahhare az żaghīne va baghżā be eṣlāḥ-e ʿālam pardāzand tā nūr-e ettefāq ʿālam rā akhdh namāyad va ʿadāvat-hā-ye maknūne dar ṣodūr sāken shavad va zāyel gardad.

Replies have been revealed to the petitions sent to the Most Holy Court. I ask God that all the friends in that land may be illumined by the radiance of the light of the Sun of Truth shining from the horizon of the Tablet, become ablaze with the wondrous, exalted fire, and arise in unity and concord. May they devote themselves to the betterment of the world with radiant hearts purified of rancor and hatred, so that the light of concord may encompass the world and the enmities concealed in human hearts may subside and disappear.

163

امید هست که اهل بها روح العالم فداهم کمر همّت را محکم نمایند و فساد و نزاع و جدال و سفک دماء را از عالم بردارند تا عالم بیچاره نفس راحتی برآرد من این را میگویم ولکن هیهات هیهات میشنوم چه که بعضی از نفوس امر اللّه را سهل شمرده‌اند یلعبون و لا یعرفون و یقولون ما لا یشعرون

Omīd hast ke ahl-e Bahā rūḥu al-ʿālam fidāhum kamar-e hemmat rā moḥkam namāyand va fasād va nezāʿ va jedāl va safk-e demā rā az ʿālam bardārand tā ʿālam-e bīchāre nafas-e rāḥatī barārad. Man īn rā mīgūyam va lāken hayhāt hayhāt mīshenavam che ke baʿżī az nofūs amr-e Allāh rā sahl shemorde-and. Yalʿabūna wa-lā yaʿrifūna wa-yaqūlūna mā lā yashʿurūn.
